overview: 今日共收录72篇文献，覆盖机器学习、计算物理和功能材料方向。
trends: 文献主要涉及结构—性质建模、有限温度/动力学模拟以及材料电子与磁性问题；缺少原文细节的条目不作定量推断。

full_list.title_en: Quantum-accurate atomistic modeling of enzyme catalysis using a machine learned potential
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Quantum-accurate atomistic modeling of enzyme catalysis using a machine learned potential
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.09293v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electronic rearrangements associated with bond forming/breaking in catalytic enzymes require quantum mechanical (QM) treatment beyond classical molecular mechanics (MM). Hybrid QM/MM methods enable tractable simulations but require system-specific setup and are sensitive to the QM region choice and treatment of the QM/MM interface. We demonstrate quantum-accurate treatment of all-atom, complete enzymes in explicit solvent comprising up to 54k atoms and 1 microsecond of total simulation time using the machine-learned interatomic potential (MLIP) eSEN-omol. We reproduce experimental barrier trends for Claisen rearrangement in chorismate mutase, resolve critical intermediate states in PETase catalyzed polymer depolymerization, and distinguish mechanistic alternatives for metal-activated phosphoryl transfer in nucleoside diphosphate kinase. We realize 1000x speedups relative to typical QM/MM calculations without system-specific tuning. These results establish MLIPs as a practical route to QM-accurate simulations of enzyme catalysis.
full_list.summary: 论文利用机器学习原子间势对完整酶、显式溶剂和大规模原子体系进行近量子精度模拟，并研究多种酶催化反应的能垒和中间态。结果显示，该方法可在显著降低计算成本的同时再现实验能垒趋势和区分反应机制。
full_list.focus_summary: 论文利用机器学习原子间势对完整酶、显式溶剂和大规模原子体系进行近量子精度模拟，并研究多种酶催化反应的能垒和中间态。结果显示，该方法可在显著降低计算成本的同时再现实验能垒趋势和区分反应机制。
full_list.focus_relation: 研究对象是生物酶催化，并非团队主要关注的功能材料或凝聚态体系，因此直接相关性较低。其机器学习势、长时间分子动力学和主动构建高精度势能面的技术思路，对材料中的缺陷扩散、离子迁移和非绝热动力学仍有方法学借鉴价值。
full_list.focus_suggestion: 可重点阅读其机器学习势的训练数据策略、化学反应描述能力和长时间稳定性验证。若迁移到团队方向，可尝试用于卤化物钙钛矿动态缺陷、固态电解质反应和界面电荷转移模拟。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对《Quantum-accurate atomistic modeling of enzyme catalysis using a machine learned potential》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Octahedral-field-informed machine learning for accelerated discovery of two-dimensional magnets with perpendicular magnetic anisotropy
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Octahedral-field-informed machine learning for accelerated discovery of two-dimensional magnets with perpendicular magnetic anisotropy
full_list.abstract: Author(s): Yanyan Yang, Xinyu Chen, Qian Xia, Qionghua Zhou, Qian Chen, and Jinlan Wang Magnetic anisotropy is a fundamental prerequisite for stabilizing long-range order in two-dimensional (2D) magnets, yet its evaluation via first-principles methods is computationally prohibitive for large-scale material discovery. Here, an octahedral-field-informed machine learning framework is repo… [Phys. Rev. Applied 26, 034023] Published Thu Sep 10, 2026
full_list.summary: 该工作针对二维磁体中垂直磁各向异性难以通过大规模第一性原理计算高效评估的问题，构建了融入八面体晶场物理信息的机器学习框架。其目标是快速筛选具有稳定长程磁序潜力的二维磁性材料，并以物理先验提升预测与材料发现效率。
full_list.focus_summary: 该工作针对二维磁体中垂直磁各向异性难以通过大规模第一性原理计算高效评估的问题，构建了融入八面体晶场物理信息的机器学习框架。其目标是快速筛选具有稳定长程磁序潜力的二维磁性材料，并以物理先验提升预测与材料发现效率。
full_list.focus_relation: 与团队的二维范德华磁体、磁各向异性、自旋轨道耦合、机器学习势和图神经网络材料筛选方向高度直接相关。八面体晶场特征与物理约束机器学习的思路可用于团队的自旋哈密顿量、磁交换参数及磁性拓扑性质预测。
full_list.focus_suggestion: 建议重点阅读其特征构造、训练数据来源、泛化验证及候选材料的第一性原理复核流程。可进一步将晶场描述符与等变图神经网络结合，联合预测磁各向异性、交换作用和居里温度，并开展主动学习高通量筛选。
full_list.method_point: 该工作针对二维磁体中决定有限温磁序稳定性的垂直磁各向异性，以八面体晶场信息构造机器学习框架，替代对每个候选物逐一实施昂贵SOC第一性原理磁各向异性能计算。输入应围绕金属离子的配位八面体、配体种类和畸变所决定的d轨道分裂及占据特征，模型学习这些局域晶场量与易轴各向异性的关联，再服务大规模候选筛选。摘要未披露具体回归器、训练集规模和DFT泛函，不能据此假定其已准确处理非共线磁序或长程交换；其物理价值在于显式编码晶场先验。
full_list.related_work: 该思路与用结构描述符预测磁各向异性、Curie温度和交换常数的高通量工作相连，但比黑箱成分回归更贴近SOC、轨道矩和八面体畸变的微观来源。它可同Hongjun Xiang的群论、自旋哈密顿量和磁电耦合研究，以及Hongyu Yu的等变网络自旋-晶格模型结合。CrI3和CrSBr均可作为团队熟悉的对照体系：前者具有强各向异性与卤素SOC，后者低对称晶格导致显著面内各向异性，因而不应把八面体描述符机械外推为普适的垂直易轴判据。
full_list.implication: 可先用CrI3、CrBr3、CrCl3及含畸变配位的CrSBr构建基准集，在固定磁序下以含SOC的DFT+U计算不同自旋方向总能，并提取局域键长、键角、配体原子序数、晶场分裂和轨道磁矩。训练晶场描述符模型与MACE等变GNN并行预测单离子各向异性和MAE，再将候选物的J、D和各向异性代入自旋哈密顿量蒙特卡洛。验证包括留族元素外推、应变下易轴翻转、与显式SOC复算的误差，以及由磁各向异性推得的有限温磁化曲线。

full_list.title_en: uFlowCSP: Crystal Structure Prediction using Mean flow generative models
full_list.title_zh: uFlowCSP：利用平均流生成模型进行晶体结构预测
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.09799v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Crystal structure prediction (CSP) is fundamental to computational materials discovery. Generative models including CDVAE, DiffCSP, FlowMM, and CrystalFlow learn stable-crystal distributions directly, but diffusion and flow-matching inference requires tens to thousands of sequential network evaluations per candidate. We introduce uFlowCSP, a MeanFlow-based CSP model that learns the average, rather than instantaneous, probability-flow velocity. It generates a complete structure in one to five evaluations, delivering 5x-58x faster inference with equal or better performance. A chemistry- and symmetry-aware Transformer uses canonical atom ordering, global composition, and per-token chemistry embeddings. A coarse crystal-system token is used only during training; it provides additive gains, particularly improving space-group agreement despite being absent at inference, which remains formula-only. On MP-20 with 20 candidates per target, one step matches CrystalFlow (78.38% vs. 78.34%) with 100x fewer evaluations and about 10x lower wall-clock time. Five steps reach 83.64%, exceeding CrystalFlow (78.34% at 2,000 evaluations) and DiffCSP (77.93% at about 20,000), while using 20x fewer evaluations. uFlowCSP generates 10,000 structures in 0.39-1.31 minutes, versus 6.5 for CrystalFlow and 76.1 for DiffCSP. Under CSPBench's energy-ranked top-five structure-and-space-group criterion, five-step uFlowCSP reaches 72%/72%/65% structure, space-group, and consensus match rates. CrystalFlow reaches 78%/73%/68% at 100 steps but falls to 49%/32%/31% at five. Thus, uFlowCSP improves accuracy per network evaluation, not merely peak accuracy.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文提出uFlowCSP，一种基于MeanFlow的晶体结构预测模型，通过学习平均概率流速度而非瞬时速度，将每个候选结构的生成评估次数降低至1至5次。该模型结合化学和对称性感知的Transformer，在保持或提升精度的同时实现了显著加速；在MP-20数据集上，单步推理即可匹配CrystalFlow的性能，五步推理则取得更高的结构预测准确率。结果表明，uFlowCSP提升了每次网络评估所获得的精度，而不仅仅是追求最高精度。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 晶体结构预测（CSP）是计算材料发现的基础。包括CDVAE、DiffCSP、FlowMM和CrystalFlow在内的生成模型能够直接学习稳定晶体的分布，但扩散模型和流匹配模型在推理时需要对每个候选结构进行数十次到数千次连续网络评估。本文提出uFlowCSP，一种基于MeanFlow的CSP模型，它学习平均概率流速度，而不是瞬时概率流速度。该模型只需进行1至5次评估即可生成完整结构，实现了5倍至58倍的推理加速，同时保持相当或更好的性能。模型采用具有化学和对称性感知能力的Transformer，并结合规范化原子排序、全局组成信息以及逐标记化学嵌入。在训练阶段，模型还使用粗粒度晶体系统标记；尽管该标记在推理时被移除、推理仍仅依赖化学式，但它能够带来额外收益，尤其可以改善空间群的一致性。在MP-20数据集上，对于每个目标生成20个候选结构时，单步推理的结构匹配率为78.38%，与CrystalFlow的78.34%相当，但网络评估次数减少了100倍，实际耗时约降低10倍。五步推理的匹配率达到83.64%，高于CrystalFlow在2,000次评估下的78.34%和DiffCSP在约20,000次评估下的77.93%，同时评估次数减少了20倍。uFlowCSP生成10,000个结构仅需0.39至1.31分钟，而CrystalFlow和DiffCSP分别需要6.5分钟和76.1分钟。在CSPBench的按能量排序的前五个结构与空间群评价标准下，五步uFlowCSP的结构、空间群和共识匹配率分别达到72%、72%和65%。CrystalFlow在100步推理下的相应结果为78%、73%和68%，但在五步推理时下降至49%、32%和31%。因此，uFlowCSP提升的是每次网络评估所对应的精度，而不仅仅是最高精度。
full_list.summary: 本文提出uFlowCSP，一种基于MeanFlow的晶体结构预测模型，通过学习平均概率流速度而非瞬时速度，将每个候选结构的生成评估次数降低至1至5次。该模型结合化学和对称性感知的Transformer，在保持或提升精度的同时实现了显著加速；在MP-20数据集上，单步推理即可匹配CrystalFlow的性能，五步推理则取得更高的结构预测准确率。结果表明，uFlowCSP提升了每次网络评估所获得的精度，而不仅仅是追求最高精度。
full_list.focus_summary: 该工作提出 uFlowCSP，利用 MeanFlow 生成模型进行晶体结构预测，通过学习平均概率流速度，将结构生成所需的网络评估次数降低到 1 至 5 次。模型结合化学组成、原子排序和晶体对称性信息，在 MP-20 数据集上以更低推理成本取得了与现有扩散或流匹配方法相当甚至更好的性能。
full_list.focus_relation: 与我们的晶体结构预测、高通量筛选、机器学习和逆向材料设计方向高度相关。其快速生成策略可用于扩大铁电、磁性、二维材料和固态电解质候选空间，并与第一性原理计算形成主动学习闭环。
full_list.focus_suggestion: 建议评估该方法在磁性、极性结构、含缺陷晶体和二维范德华异质结构中的泛化能力，尤其关注磁序和空间群约束是否能够被可靠保留。可进一步将生成模型与 DFT 稳定性计算、性质预测模型和主动学习结合。
full_list.method_point: uFlowCSP采用MeanFlow生成式建模进行晶体结构预测，学习平均概率流速度而非传统流模型沿时间的瞬时速度，从而以每个候选结构约1至5次网络评估完成生成。网络使用同时感知化学组成和对称性的Transformer，在给定组分条件下输出晶格与原子位置的去噪或流动更新；MP-20基准中单步性能可比CrystalFlow，五步更新进一步提高结构匹配率。方法的关键是将少步采样目标纳入训练，使网络每次评估承担更长时间跨度的生成校正，而不是依赖许多小步数值积分。
full_list.related_work: 它与扩散式CSP、正常化流、CrystalFlow以及基于图网络的结构生成工作同属逆向晶体设计，但优化重点从最终大量采样步数转为平均流的少步高保真推断。与Hongyu Yu、Xin-Gao Gong的主动学习MLIP工作可形成前后衔接：生成模型提出新结构，等变势快速弛豫并筛除不稳定候选。对于铁电HfO2、BaTiO3衍生物和二维滑移铁电，空间群条件很重要，但生成的高对称初始结构仍可能遗漏极性畸变、层间滑移及多畴自由度，必须结合软模和能垒搜索。
full_list.implication: 可将uFlowCSP用于含Hf-Zr-O、层状卤素硫族物或Cr-X体系的成分约束生成，训练前以Materials Project结构加团队DFT弛豫的极性和磁性结构扩充语料，并显式保留空间群、层数和化学计量条件。生成后先以MACE或NEP在零压及目标应变下弛豫，再以DFT+U+SOC复算形成能、声子和磁交换；铁电候选需沿极性模式计算Berry相极化与NEB翻转势垒。评价不能只报结构匹配率，还应统计生成后动力学稳定率、极性相相对能和目标磁各向异性命中率。

full_list.title_en: Strong Impact of Halide Ordering on Structural Phase Transitions in Mixed Perovskites
full_list.title_zh: 卤素排序对混合钙钛矿结构相变的显著影响
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.09956v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Mixed halide perovskites are highly versatile semiconductors with applications in photovoltaics, light-emitting diodes, and photodetectors. Understanding their thermodynamic phase behavior is central to guiding compositional design and improving device stability. Here, we train machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) on density functional theory reference data for CsxRb1-xPbBr3yI3-3y, CsxRb1-xPbBr3yCl3-3y, and CsxRb1-xPbCl3yI3-3y halide perovskites, enabling large-scale hybrid Monte Carlo-molecular dynamics simulations that sample both configurational and vibrational degrees of freedom. All three binary halide systems exhibit a miscibility gap, the extent of which correlates with halide ion size mismatch. The gaps in Br-Cl and Br-I close at low temperatures, while the Cl-I gap extends above room temperature. At temperatures above the miscibility gap (200 K to 500 K), all systems show a tendency toward layered halide ordering, with halide species preferentially occupying apical or equatorial octahedral sites. In CsPbBr3yI3-3y, this ordering occurs in a device-relevant temperature regime and is linked to the structural phase transitions, shifting transition temperatures by up to 100 K relative to randomly mixed structures. We attribute the strongly non-linear composition dependence of the orthorhombic-tetragonal phase boundary observed experimentally (a linear decrease followed by a plateau) to halide ordering. Introducing Rb on the A-site weakens halide ordering and eliminates the non-linear behavior, while narrowing the miscibility gap in both the Br-I and Br-Cl systems. These results establish halide ordering as a key determinant of structural phase stability in mixed-halide perovskites.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文针对CsxRb1-xPbBr3yI3-3y、CsxRb1-xPbBr3yCl3-3y和CsxRb1-xPbCl3yI3-3y卤化物钙钛矿，基于密度泛函理论数据训练机器学习原子间势，并开展同时采样构型与振动自由度的大尺度混合蒙特卡洛-分子动力学模拟。三种二元卤素体系均表现出与卤素离子尺寸失配相关的混溶间隙，并倾向于形成层状卤素排序。结果表明，卤素排序是决定混合卤素钙钛矿结构相稳定性的关键因素，并可使相变温度相对于随机混合结构改变最多100 K。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 混合卤素钙钛矿是用途广泛的半导体，可应用于光伏、发光二极管和光电探测器。理解其热力学相行为对于指导成分设计和提高器件稳定性至关重要。本文利用密度泛函理论参考数据，为CsxRb1-xPbBr3yI3-3y、CsxRb1-xPbBr3yCl3-3y和CsxRb1-xPbCl3yI3-3y卤化物钙钛矿训练了机器学习原子间势（MLIP），从而能够开展同时采样构型自由度和振动自由度的大尺度混合蒙特卡洛-分子动力学模拟。三种二元卤素体系均表现出混溶间隙，其范围与卤素离子之间的尺寸失配相关。Br-Cl和Br-I体系中的混溶间隙在低温下闭合，而Cl-I体系的混溶间隙则延伸至室温以上。在高于混溶间隙的温度范围内，即200 K至500 K，所有体系都表现出形成层状卤素排序的倾向，其中不同卤素优先占据八面体的顶端位点或赤道位点。在CsPbBr3yI3-3y中，这种排序发生在与器件相关的温度范围内，并与结构相变相关；相对于随机混合结构，它使相变温度最多移动100 K。我们将实验观察到的正交相-四方相边界对成分的强非线性依赖，即先线性下降后出现平台，归因于卤素排序。在A位引入Rb会削弱卤素排序并消除这种非线性行为，同时缩小Br-I和Br-Cl体系中的混溶间隙。这些结果表明，卤素排序是决定混合卤素钙钛矿结构相稳定性的关键因素。
full_list.summary: 本文针对CsxRb1-xPbBr3yI3-3y、CsxRb1-xPbBr3yCl3-3y和CsxRb1-xPbCl3yI3-3y卤化物钙钛矿，基于密度泛函理论数据训练机器学习原子间势，并开展同时采样构型与振动自由度的大尺度混合蒙特卡洛-分子动力学模拟。三种二元卤素体系均表现出与卤素离子尺寸失配相关的混溶间隙，并倾向于形成层状卤素排序。结果表明，卤素排序是决定混合卤素钙钛矿结构相稳定性的关键因素，并可使相变温度相对于随机混合结构改变最多100 K。
full_list.focus_summary: 该工作针对混合卤化物钙钛矿，基于密度泛函理论数据训练机器学习原子间势，并结合混合蒙特卡洛分子动力学模拟构型和振动自由度。研究发现不同卤素体系存在与离子尺寸失配相关的混溶间隙，并在一定温度范围内形成层状卤素有序排列。
full_list.focus_relation: 与我们的机器学习势、钙钛矿材料、蒙特卡洛模拟、分子动力学和相变研究高度相关。其结合构型无序与晶格振动的方法可用于研究卤素迁移、离子有序、动态缺陷及器件稳定性。
full_list.focus_suggestion: 可进一步将该类机器学习势用于含缺陷、应变或界面的混合卤化物钙钛矿，并研究卤素有序与载流子输运、非辐射复合和光致相分离之间的关系。建议重点阅读其势函数训练集构建、主动学习策略及混合蒙特卡洛实现。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入热力学知情 ML、机器学习势、自由能采样、CALPHAD/团簇展开。从摘要能确认的线索包括：分子动力学与有限温度轨迹, 密度泛函理论和电子结构计算, 蒙特卡洛统计采样，以及晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“在 DFT 能量/力/应力之外加入跨温度构型、相对自由能、熵或热膨胀信息；用主动学习补采相变、畴壁和相竞争区域，再用热力学积分、MC 或有限温度 MD 验证”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：热力学知情 ML、机器学习势、自由能采样、CALPHAD/团簇展开已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到HfO₂ 基铁电、二维滑移铁电、钙钛矿和磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的热力学知情 ML、机器学习势、自由能采样、CALPHAD/团簇展开嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在HfO₂ 基铁电、二维滑移铁电、钙钛矿和磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“在 DFT 能量/力/应力之外加入跨温度构型、相对自由能、熵或热膨胀信息；用主动学习补采相变、畴壁和相竞争区域，再用热力学积分、MC 或有限温度 MD 验证”补充训练/验证集，再比较《卤素排序对混合钙钛矿结构相变的显著影响》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: SSCHA-based evolutionary crystal structure prediction at finite temperatures with account for quantum nuclear motion
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：SSCHA-based evolutionary crystal structure prediction at finite temperatures with account for quantum nuclear motion
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2512.24849v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Reliable crystal structure prediction (CSP) at finite temperatures, including quantum anharmonic effects, remains challenging but is particularly important for systems containing light atoms such as superconducting hydrides. Here, we integrate machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) with the stochastic self-consistent harmonic approximation (SSCHA) to enable evolutionary CSP on the quantum anharmonic free-energy landscape. Using LaH10 as a test case, we compare three approaches: (i) active-learning MLIPs (AL-MLIPs) trained on the fly, (ii) universal MLIPs (uMLIPs), and (iii) temperature-dependent effective potentials (TDEPs) trained on SSCHA ensemble data. AL-MLIPs correctly predict the cubic Fm-3m phase but require thermodynamic perturbation theory corrections for consistent results. The foundation uMLIP Mattersim-5m enables SSCHA-based CSP without per-structure training, but fine-tuning is required for higher accuracy. Temperature-dependent effective potentials trained on SSCHA data enable accurate and very efficient CSP for large unit cells on the quantum anharmonic free-energy landscape. We demonstrate that quantum anharmonicity simplifies the free-energy landscape and is essential for the correct energy ranking of LaH10 structures.
full_list.summary: 该工作将机器学习原子间势与随机自洽谐近似结合，用于考虑量子核效应和非谐自由能的有限温度进化晶体结构预测。以LaH10为例，结果表明在线主动学习势、通用势微调及基于SSCHA数据训练的温度相关有效势均可支持结构搜索，其中后者在大晶胞计算中兼具较高精度和效率。
full_list.focus_summary: 该工作将机器学习原子间势与随机自洽谐近似结合，用于考虑量子核效应和非谐自由能的有限温度进化晶体结构预测。以LaH10为例，结果表明在线主动学习势、通用势微调及基于SSCHA数据训练的温度相关有效势均可支持结构搜索，其中后者在大晶胞计算中兼具较高精度和效率。
full_list.focus_relation: 与团队的机器学习势、主动学习、晶体结构预测、分子动力学及超导材料研究方向直接相关。其以自由能面而非零温势能面驱动结构搜索的思路，可借鉴到轻元素体系、量子铁电体和有限温度相变材料。
full_list.focus_suggestion: 可重点阅读其SSCHA数据构造、热力学微扰校正和势函数验证流程，并评估其对HfO2基铁电体或氢化物相稳定性的适用性。可进一步发展同时描述极化、应变和非谐振动的温度依赖机器学习势。
full_list.method_point: 该工作把机器学习原子间势嵌入随机自洽谐近似SSCHA与进化式晶体结构预测，在有限温自由能面上同时考虑强非谐振动和量子核涨落。MLIP承担大量能量与力评估，SSCHA以随机采样的高斯试探密度矩阵优化有效力常数和结构，进化搜索则在候选构型间迭代选择、交叉和变异。该组合避免只依据0 K静态焓排序，尤其适合含轻原子的超导氢化物；摘要未给出势模型类型、压力温度网格及SSCHA收敛阈值，复现时需单独设定。
full_list.related_work: 这比常规AIRSS或USPEX加静态DFT弛豫更接近实验热力学条件，也比经典MLIP-MD更能处理质子零点能和量子非谐性。它与Xin-Gao Gong的MLIP、相变和电子-声子耦合研究密切相关，并可延展Weibin Chu采用路径积分MD描述轻离子或极化子核效应的路线。HfO2和BaTiO3的铁电软模虽以重原子为主，仍存在显著非谐自由能；卤化物钙钛矿的转动、氢键和离子迁移则更需要有限温结构而非单点晶格优化。
full_list.implication: 可在BaTiO3、HfO2和含氢卤化物钙钛矿上建立分阶段验证：用PBEsol或SCAN标注多相、软模位移、应变和高温MD快照，再主动学习训练MACE或NEP势。对每个候选相在实验相关温压下运行SSCHA，输出自由能、重整化声子和平均结构；对含氢体系增加路径积分MD交叉检查零点能。以DFT自由能抽样点、实验相变温度、介电软模频率和极化分布验证，并将低自由能极性相进一步用Berry相极化和NEB确定可翻转性。

full_list.title_en: Fast, Accurate, and Scalable Fermionic Neural Networks via Translation Equivariance
full_list.title_zh: 通过平移等变性实现快速、精确且可扩展的费米子神经网络
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.10186v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We demonstrate that designing a neural quantum state to be an exact eigenstate of the Hamiltonian's symmetries significantly improves both training speed and final variational energy. For the 2D electron gas, we design TorFormer, a neural network wavefunction which is an exact eigenstate of the total momentum. TorFormer describes both the Fermi liquid and Wigner crystal with no supervision and significantly outperforms Psiformer-based references up to large system sizes. For rₛ = 30.0 and 40.0 at N=91, we compare TorFormer trained for 8K steps against the previous best NQS, which required 100K training steps. Our improvement to the total energy at rₛ = 40.0, excluding the trivial Madelung part, is 0.12%---enormous compared to the tiny differences separating phases. Relative to Slater-Jastrow-backflow diffusion Monte Carlo, TorFormer's energy decrease is roughly 9.8 times that of the previous best NQS. Our work demonstrates that neural quantum states can both accurately and efficiently solve large-scale problems.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文表明，使神经量子态成为哈密顿量对称性的精确本征态，能够显著提高训练速度并降低最终变分能量。针对二维电子气，作者构建了具有总动量精确本征性的TorFormer，在无监督条件下同时描述费米液体和维格纳晶体，并在较大体系中显著优于基于Psiformer的参考方法。结果显示，该方法能够高效求解大规模量子多体问题，并在区分竞争相所需的微小能量差方面取得明显改进。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们证明，使神经量子态成为哈密顿量对称性的精确本征态，能够显著提升训练速度并降低最终的变分能量。针对二维电子气，我们设计了TorFormer，这是一种具有总动量精确本征性的神经网络波函数。TorFormer无需监督即可同时描述费米液体和维格纳晶体，并且在较大体系尺寸下显著优于基于Psiformer的参考方法。对于rs=30.0和40.0、粒子数N=91的体系，我们将经过8K步训练的TorFormer与此前最优的神经量子态进行比较，后者需要进行100K步训练。在rs=40.0时，除去平凡的马德隆项后，我们对总能量的改进达到0.12%；与区分不同相所需的微小能量差相比，这一改进十分显著。相对于Slater-Jastrow-回馈扩散蒙特卡洛方法，TorFormer带来的能量降低约为此前最佳神经量子态的9.8倍。我们的工作表明，神经量子态能够高精度且高效率地求解大规模问题。
full_list.summary: 本文表明，使神经量子态成为哈密顿量对称性的精确本征态，能够显著提高训练速度并降低最终变分能量。针对二维电子气，作者构建了具有总动量精确本征性的TorFormer，在无监督条件下同时描述费米液体和维格纳晶体，并在较大体系中显著优于基于Psiformer的参考方法。结果显示，该方法能够高效求解大规模量子多体问题，并在区分竞争相所需的微小能量差方面取得明显改进。
full_list.focus_summary: 该工作提出具有平移等变性的 TorFormer 神经量子态，用于高效求解二维电子气的基态波函数。结果表明，显式满足总动量对称性能够提升训练速度和变分能精度，并改善对费米液体与 Wigner 晶体的描述。
full_list.focus_relation: 与我们的机器学习和量子多体模拟存在方法上的间接联系，但研究对象主要是二维均匀电子气，而非具体材料的电子结构、原子势能或材料性质预测。其对称性约束神经网络的思想可有限借鉴到等变电子哈密顿量和多体波函数建模中。
full_list.focus_suggestion: 可关注其平移对称性与等变神经网络的设计，并评估能否扩展到周期性晶体、磁性体系或具有自旋轨道耦合的材料。若研究重点是材料模拟，则应优先考察其与机器学习 Kohn-Sham 哈密顿量或电子密度预测的结合。
full_list.method_point: TorFormer面向周期边界二维电子气的连续坐标波函数学习，将电子坐标输入经平移等变的注意力表示，使多体神经波函数在晶格平移下严格获得指定总动量相位。模型在变分蒙特卡洛框架中以哈密顿量局域能为无监督目标优化，并用费米子反对称结构表征交换统计；作者将其与Psiformer基线比较，考察费米液体和维格纳晶体及其极小能量差。关键设计不是事后数据增强，而是在网络层面强制波函数属于平移对称群的本征表示，从而降低优化中无关自由度。
full_list.related_work: 该路线对应把守恒量、空间群或E(3)对称性嵌入模型的物理归纳偏置，与Hongyu Yu和Hongjun Xiang发展等变GNN、机器学习Kohn-Sham哈密顿量的思路一致，但对象由原子局域环境转为显式电子坐标及费米子节点。它也与量子蒙特卡洛中的Slater-Jastrow、backflow和Transformer神经量子态互补，优势在于总动量精确而非仅靠训练采样学习。对团队的铁电和磁性问题，BaTiO3软模、CrI3磁激发并非同一连续电子气模型，却同样受平移对称、有限尺寸和竞争能标解析度限制。
full_list.implication: 可先以二维电子气和小尺寸Hubbard模型复现总动量扇区能量，再将平移等变模块嵌入团队的Wannier紧束缚模型，用于FeTeSe、CrSBr或扭转范德华磁体的关联电子基态比较。数据应由DFT-Wannier给出跃迁、SOC和库仑参数，并在不同超胞、载流子密度和边界扭转相位下采样；训练采用变分能量加粒子数和动量投影约束。验证需同精确对角化或DMRG的小体系能量、结构因子和动量分布对照，并检查不同胞长下磁序或电荷序能差是否收敛。

full_list.title_en: Physics-Informed Multi-Task Surrogate Model for the Martian Nightside Thermosphere
full_list.title_zh: 面向火星夜侧热层的物理信息多任务代理模型
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.10077v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Modeling the Martian nightside thermosphere remains challenging due to sparse in situ sampling and strong coupling among transport, magnetic, and seasonal processes. Purely data-driven models can produce non-physical artifacts, such as density inversions, in poorly sampled altitude regimes. We present a multi-task physics-informed neural network that simultaneously predicts the base-10 logarithmic densities of four neutral species (O, CO₂, N₂, and Ar) using more than a decade of MAVEN/NGIMS observations (MY 32-38, 2014-2025). A shared backbone learns a common representation of the nightside thermospheric state and branches into species-specific output heads. A weak monotonicity prior is incorporated via automatic differentiation by penalizing positive vertical gradients in logarithmic density. Experiments using an orbit-disjoint train/validation/test split show that physics-informed regularization substantially reduces non-physical inversions while preserving predictive skill and slightly improving it in the best-performing configuration, as measured by RMSE, MAE, and R². The resulting model provides a computationally efficient surrogate for nightside thermospheric reconstruction with improved vertical consistency.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种多任务物理信息神经网络，同时预测火星夜侧热层中O、CO₂、N₂和Ar四种中性成分的十进制对数密度。模型利用共享骨干网络学习共同状态表示，并通过惩罚对数密度的正垂直梯度来抑制非物理性的密度反转。基于轨道不相交的数据划分，实验显示物理信息正则化显著减少了反转现象，同时保持或略微提升预测性能。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 由于原位采样稀疏，以及输运、磁场和季节过程之间存在强耦合，火星夜侧热层的建模仍然具有挑战性。纯数据驱动模型在采样不足的高度范围内可能产生非物理伪影，例如密度反转。我们提出一种多任务物理信息神经网络，利用超过十年的MAVEN/NGIMS观测数据（火星年份32至38年，2014年至2025年），同时预测四种中性成分（O、CO₂、N₂和Ar）的十进制对数密度。一个共享骨干网络学习夜侧热层状态的共同表示，并分支出面向不同成分的专用输出头。我们通过自动微分将弱单调性先验纳入模型，具体做法是惩罚对数密度的正垂直梯度。采用轨道不相交的训练集、验证集和测试集划分的实验表明，物理信息正则化显著减少了非物理性的密度反转，同时保持了预测能力；在表现最佳的配置中，它还带来了小幅性能提升，这一点由RMSE、MAE和R²衡量。最终得到的模型为夜侧热层重建提供了计算效率较高的代理模型，并改善了垂直方向的一致性。
full_list.summary: 本文提出一种多任务物理信息神经网络，同时预测火星夜侧热层中O、CO₂、N₂和Ar四种中性成分的十进制对数密度。模型利用共享骨干网络学习共同状态表示，并通过惩罚对数密度的正垂直梯度来抑制非物理性的密度反转。基于轨道不相交的数据划分，实验显示物理信息正则化显著减少了反转现象，同时保持或略微提升预测性能。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《面向火星夜侧热层的物理信息多任务代理模型》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Nonperturbative functional renormalization group for Higgs-singlet models with physics-informed neural networks
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Nonperturbative functional renormalization group for Higgs-singlet models with physics-informed neural networks
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.08470v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We develop a nonperturbative functional renormalization group framework within the LPA' to solve the Wetterich flow equation for the Z₂-symmetric real singlet extension of the Standard Model at zero and finite temperature, without a polynomial expansion of the scale-dependent effective potential, using a physics-informed neural network (PINN) representation. In contrast to conventional truncations based on low-order field expansions, our hybrid tree-level--plus--neural-network ansatz yields a continuous, mesh-free description of the effective potential over the full relevant field and scale range. As a proof of concept, we apply the framework to the finite-temperature effective potential relevant to the electroweak phase transition in this model: one-dimensional field-space slices at two benchmark temperatures, and a two-dimensional reconstruction at T=100 GeV from which a two-step bounce action is extracted. The renormalization group flow is implemented in a multi-domain setup in scale and field space with derivative matching conditions that ensure smoothness and numerical stability. Gauge and Yukawa sectors are incorporated via independently computed perturbative two-loop running couplings, and anomalous dimensions are included in the flow at the LPA' level. We benchmark the network against resummed perturbation theory and against a grid-based relaxation solver of the same equation. Finally, we introduce a soft consistency constraint that keeps the solution close, in sign and order of magnitude, to perturbation theory across the field-space domain; we find it necessary, rather than merely helpful, for selecting a physically sensible solution of the flow equation, and find that the converged result retains a residual dependence on this guidance -- through hand-tuned weights and an analytic thermal target -- which we identify as the central open problem.

full_list.title_en: Physics-informed neural networks by Gradient-Guided Gaussian Adaptive Sampling (3GAS-PINNs)
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Physics-informed neural networks by Gradient-Guided Gaussian Adaptive Sampling (3GAS-PINNs)
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.09162v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) provide a mesh-free framework for solving partial differential equations, yet their performance in nonlinear problems is often limited by slow convergence, gradient imbalance, and insufficient resolution to capture localized intermittent structures such as shock waves[1]. These issues arise primarily from the use of fixed weights of loss and uniform collocation point distributions, which cannot adapt to the evolving complexity of the solution field during training. To address these challenges, Gradient-Guided Gaussian Adaptive Sampling Physics-Informed Neural Networks (3GAS-PINNs) is proposed in this paper, which combines uniform probability distribution and Gaussian-smoothed probability distribution derived from the spatial gradients of solution, to maintain global constraint satisfaction as well as concentrating collocation points in regions of high gradient. Thus, intermittency structures like shock wave and solitons can be accurately captured. The method is evaluated on three benchmark nonlinear problems, including one-dimensional forced Burgers equation, Korteweg-de Vries (KdV) equation and nonlinear Schrodinger equation, all of which exhibit steep gradients or strong nonlinearity. In comparison with baseline PINNs, 3GAS-PINNs can effectively promote the physical consistency in intermittent regions. The accuracy of the numerical simulation can be improved by a factor of up to 14.

full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对《Physics-informed neural networks by Gradient-Guided Gaussian Adaptive Sampling (3GAS-PINNs)》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: High-quality, high-information datasets for universal atomistic machine learning
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：High-quality, high-information datasets for universal atomistic machine learning
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2603.02089v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The quality, consistency, and information content of training data is often what determines the practical value of machine-learning models for atomistic simulations. Yet, many widely used electronic-structure databases are assembled having materials screening as primary goal rather than robust force-field learning, are limited in their scope to a specific class of chemical compounds, and/or employ inconsistent DFT functionals and settings. Here we introduce MAD-1.6, a highly curated dataset designed explicitly for training broadly applicable atomistic models across the periodic table at high levels of theory. MAD-1.6 extends the MAD dataset with targeted enrichment strategies that improve the coverage of chemical space to 102 elements while keeping the total number of configurations compact. All structures are computed with a single, standardized all-electron DFT workflow using the r²SCAN meta-GGA functional and consistent convergence settings, ensuring uniformity across chemically heterogeneous systems. The dataset encompasses molecules, clusters, bulk crystals, surfaces, and low-dimensional structures, and its quality and consistency are further enhanced by outlier removal using uncertainty quantification. We demonstrate the high accuracy that can be achieved with the proposed dataset by training PET-MAD-1.6, a generally applicable r²SCAN interatomic potential that covers 102 elements in the periodic table and achieves exceptional levels of benchmark accuracy and stability in challenging simulation protocols.
full_list.summary: 该工作发布了 MAD-1.6 高质量原子级机器学习数据集，采用统一的全电子 DFT 流程和 r²SCAN 泛函，覆盖 102 种元素以及分子、团簇、块体、表面和低维结构。数据集通过针对性扩充化学空间和提高数据一致性，旨在支持具有广泛适用性的机器学习原子模型和势函数训练。
full_list.focus_summary: 该工作发布了 MAD-1.6 高质量原子级机器学习数据集，采用统一的全电子 DFT 流程和 r²SCAN 泛函，覆盖 102 种元素以及分子、团簇、块体、表面和低维结构。数据集通过针对性扩充化学空间和提高数据一致性，旨在支持具有广泛适用性的机器学习原子模型和势函数训练。
full_list.focus_relation: 与我们的机器学习势、等变图神经网络、分子动力学、材料信息学和高通量计算方向直接相关。统一计算设置与多类型结构覆盖有助于训练跨化学体系的势能、力和张量性质模型，并可作为主动学习数据集的基准。
full_list.focus_suggestion: 建议比较 MAD-1.6 对不同等变神经网络、长程库仑模型和自旋相关机器学习势的影响，重点测试铁电、磁性、缺陷和界面体系。还可评估其在非绝热动力学、离子迁移、热输运和极化翻转等任务中的数据覆盖不足。
full_list.method_point: 该文聚焦通用原子机器学习所需训练集的质量、一致性和信息量，指出面向材料筛选构建的电子结构数据库通常不足以直接训练稳定的力场。其方法学核心是以原子构型覆盖、能量和力标签一致性、化学空间多样性及高应力或缺陷态信息密度评价数据，而非只累计平衡晶体条目。摘要未给出完整数据源、标注泛函和模型基准参数，因此实际使用时不能把它等同于已可下载的统一势函数数据集；重点应视为数据策展和评测准则。
full_list.related_work: 这与MACE、NequIP、Allegro、NEP等等变或局域机器学习势对力标签、非平衡构型和元素覆盖的依赖直接呼应，也解释了MP、OQMD等以静态形成能筛选为主的数据难以支撑长时间MD。Hongyu Yu的可迁移MLIP和带电缺陷电子结构、Xin-Gao Gong的主动学习与缺陷动力学、Weibin Chu的非绝热动力学均受此约束。对于HfO2相变、钙钛矿离子迁移、CrI3自旋-晶格耦合，单纯0 K理想胞数据不能覆盖畴壁、缺陷、电荷态和高温涨落。
full_list.implication: 团队可建立按任务分层的数据协议：以DFT+U或杂化泛函统一标注HfO2、BaTiO3、CrI3和卤化物钙钛矿的能量、力、应力、磁矩及必要张量，平衡相仅作种子集。随后从升温降温MD、应变扫描、NEB鞍点、畴壁、表面、空位和带电缺陷主动选择高不确定构型，并保留电子温度、U值、SOC和自旋初态元数据。验证应独立测试声子、弹性、缺陷迁移垒、相变温度和长程MD稳定性，同时以委员会方差和外推构型比例审计可迁移范围。

full_list.title_en: Development and Validation of a Physics-Guided Machine Learning Extrapolation Framework Using a Classical Transient Diffusion Benchmark
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Development and Validation of a Physics-Guided Machine Learning Extrapolation Framework Using a Classical Transient Diffusion Benchmark
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.09912v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine learning models used in engineering are typically trained within limited operating ranges, yet reliable predictions are often required beyond these domains. Consequently, the primary challenge is extrapolation rather than interpolation. Rigorous validation is hindered by the scarcity of data outside the training range. To address this limitation, a novel extrapolation framework is integrated with established machine learning architectures to enable accurate and physically consistent predictions beyond the training domain. The framework is established by systematically evaluating two physics-guided architectures: a Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) network and a Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN). A classical one-dimensional transient diffusion problem is adopted as a benchmark because its exact analytical solution provides unlimited, reliable data across the spatio-temporal domain, enabling rigorous quantitative validation. The problem is particularly challenging because the solution evolves from an initial singularity through a strongly nonlinear transient regime before approaching a steady-state linear profile. When training data are confined to an intermediate portion of this evolution, backward extrapolation toward the singularity becomes especially demanding. To improve reliability, physics-guided coordinate transformations, boundary-aware learning strategies, and stability-enhancing temporal marching are incorporated. Extrapolation is evaluated using a train-predict-validate-extend strategy, in which validated predictions are recursively added to the training set to progressively extend the prediction horizon. The results demonstrate accurate and physically consistent predictions beyond the training domain, highlighting the framework's potential for engineering applications where data availability is limited.

full_list.title_en: Cure State Estimation in Frontal Polymerization from Temperature Fields via Cascaded Inverse-Forward Deep Learning with Uncertainty Quantification
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Cure State Estimation in Frontal Polymerization from Temperature Fields via Cascaded Inverse-Forward Deep Learning with Uncertainty Quantification
full_list.abstract: Frontal polymerization (FP) is an emerging thermoset curing strategy that enables rapid, energy-efficient manufacturing of polymers and polymer composites through self-propagating exothermic polymerization fronts. The degree of cure, the primary determinant of mechanical properties, cannot be measured directly during processing, but the accompanying temperature field carries strong, well-defined features (notably the sharp gradients across the front) that can be acquired with reasonable accuracy in real time via infrared (IR) thermography. To date this thermal signal has been used mainly to track front kinematics rather than the underlying cure state, a task complicated by uncertainty in the initial degree of cure and the convection coefficient at boundaries. We address this gap with a cascaded deep learning pipeline: an inverse Stage 1 estimates these unknown but bounded initial and boundary conditions from the early-time temperature history, and a causal recurrent forward Stage 2 predicts the evolving cure field in real time from the temperature field, conditioned on the Stage 1 estimates. Trained on a finite-element dataset spanning the operating envelope, the pipeline attains low degree-of-cure root-mean-square error (RMSE): only 1.5× above the matched Stage 2 oracle given ground-truth conditions. A four-phase uncertainty quantification pipeline yields calibrated prediction intervals spanning ~1% of the cure range with 91% marginal coverage on a held-out test split. End-to-end inference runs in ≈0.1 s per trajectory on a single graphics processing unit (GPU). The framework is a simulation-validated prototype toward real-time, IR-driven process monitoring and digital-twin deployment, with experimental validation reserved for future work.

full_list.title_en: The Structure of Emulations in Classical Spin Models: Modularity and Universality
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：The Structure of Emulations in Classical Spin Models: Modularity and Universality
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2407.13428v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The theory of spin models intersects with condensed matter physics, complex systems, graph theory, combinatorial optimization, computational complexity and neural networks. Many ensuing applications rely on the fact that complicated spin models can be transformed to simpler ones. What is the structure of such transformations? Here, we provide a framework to study and construct emulations between spin models. A spin model is a set of spin systems, and emulations are efficiently computable simulations with arbitrary energy cut-off, where a source spin system simulates a target system if, below the cut-off, the target Hamiltonian is encoded in the source Hamiltonian. We prove that emulations preserve important properties, as they induce reductions between computational problems such as computing ground states, approximating partition functions and approximate sampling from Boltzmann distributions. Emulations are modular (they can be added, scaled and composed), and allow for universality, i.e. certain spin models have maximal reach. We prove that a spin model is universal if and only if it is scalable, closed and functional complete. Because the characterization is constructive, it provides a step-by-step guide to construct emulations. We prove that the 2d Ising model with fields is universal, for which we also provide two new crossing gadgets. Finally, we show that simulations can be computed by linear programs. While some ideas of this work are contained in [1], we provide new definitions and theorems. This framework provides a toolbox for applications involving emulations of spin models.

full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Dual-unitary Circuits as a Platform for Quantum Reservoir Computing
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.09292v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum reservoir computing (QRC) is a machine learning approach which employs the internal dynamics of a physical system (the reservoir) to encode and process information. In this work, we explore the use of dual-unitary circuits in a brickwork architecture as a platform for QRC, well suited to current noisy intermediate-scale quantum devices. Dual-unitary circuits present both practical and conceptual advantages. Our results indicate that, under appropriate conditions, dual-unitarity can lead to an enhanced regime of operation: we numerically verify that it improves memory effects and nonlinear processing, and shields against finite-shot noise, mitigating exponential concentration. Moreover, dual unitarity offers an intuitive picture of how operator dynamics gives rise to memory and nonlinear processing in circuit-based reservoirs.

full_list.title_en: Fidelity-Aware Scheduling of Quantum Circuits on Multi-QPU Systems
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Fidelity-Aware Scheduling of Quantum Circuits on Multi-QPU Systems
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.09980v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: High Performance Computing-Quantum Computing (HPCQC) platforms expose multiple Quantum Processing Units (QPUs) that may differ in size, topology, native gates, and noise characteristics. For current noisy devices, errors compound along the compiled circuits quickly, and minimizing them, that is, maximizing the circuits' execution fidelity, is essential for reliable results. Fidelity depends on the compilation to a specific target device: the same high-level circuit may produce different executables and, therefore, different expected fidelities across QPUs. We present a low-overhead fidelity-aware scheduling framework for multi-QPU systems based on a Graph Neural Network (GNN) that estimates, before compilation, the expected fidelity of each circuit on each available QPU. Then, a tunable scheduler uses these estimates to control the trade-off between execution fidelity and parallelism. Results show that this framework allows for approximating an exhaustive fidelity-based assignment, saving computational resources compared to a brute-force approach that compiles each circuit on every device.

full_list.title_en: Hybrid Quantum-Classical NLP Classification with Compact Semantic Representations: An Experimental Analysis of Representation Compression
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Hybrid Quantum-Classical NLP Classification with Compact Semantic Representations: An Experimental Analysis of Representation Compression
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.10089v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language and sentence-embedding models provide rich semantic representations, but their high dimensionality poses a challenge for near-term quantum machine learning (QML), where quantum circuits can process only a limited number of input features. We investigate a hybrid quantum-classical pipeline that transforms high-dimensional sentence embeddings into compact representations for variational quantum classification. The workflow combines a pretrained sentence-embedding model, dimensionality reduction, angle encoding, a variational quantum circuit (VQC), and a classical decision layer. We systematically compare principal component analysis (PCA), neighborhood components analysis (NCA), and linear discriminant analysis (LDA), covering both unsupervised and supervised dimensionality reduction. Using the TREC question-classification dataset, we study the relationship between representation dimensionality, information retention, qubit count, and classification performance. Preliminary PCA experiments reveal a strong information bottleneck: reducing 768-dimensional embeddings to 3, 4, 5, and 8 dimensions retains about 8.2%, 10.2%, 11.9%, and 16.4% of the variance, with corresponding classification accuracies of 50.3%, 51.2%, 57.9%, and 63.4%. In contrast, supervised reduction is substantially more efficient. LDA reaches 85.3% accuracy and NCA reaches 83.1% using only 5 dimensions, under a leakage-free cross-validation protocol, compared with 85.1% for a full 384-dimensional classical baseline. These results indicate that supervised dimensionality reduction can preserve task-relevant information far more effectively than variance-based compression, making compact representations a promising route toward practical hybrid quantum-classical NLP models.

full_list.title_en: PatternFormer: Learning Multiple Solution Patterns in Reaction--Diffusion Systems
full_list.title_zh: PatternFormer：学习反应-扩散系统中的多重解模式
full_list.abstract: Many nonlinear models across physics, chemistry, and biology exhibit multiple solutions for the same parameters, and capturing this entire solution set is essential for understanding pattern-forming systems. Yet existing learned surrogates are fundamentally single-valued: neural operators map each parameter to a single output, and physics-informed neural networks converge to one branch. We develop PatternFormer (PF), a large language model-based framework for learning the multiple solutions of nonlinear partial differential equations. By transforming unordered coexisting solutions into canonical sequences, PF produces structured solution sets in a single autoregressive pass, terminating automatically for finite families and enforcing physical residual constraints for unbounded ones. On nonlinear elliptic problems it recovers all solution branches in one inference step; on Gray--Scott it generates coexisting Turing patterns, including physically valid states absent from the reference data and beyond training. PF can also be sequentially fine-tuned across multistable systems, toward general foundation models for solution landscapes.
full_list.abstract_zh: 许多非线性物理、化学和生物模型在相同参数下存在多个解，但现有学习代理模型通常只能输出单一解分支。本文提出基于大语言模型的PatternFormer框架，通过将无序共存解转化为规范序列，以一次自回归推理生成结构化解集。该方法在非线性椭圆问题和Gray-Scott系统中恢复或生成多种共存模式，并显示出跨多稳态系统顺序微调的潜力。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 物理、化学和生物学中的许多非线性模型在相同参数下呈现多个解，而捕获这一完整解集对于理解模式形成系统至关重要。然而，现有的学习代理模型在根本上是单值的：神经算子将每个参数映射为单一输出，而物理信息神经网络则收敛到一个分支。我们开发了PatternFormer（PF），这是一个基于大语言模型、用于学习非线性偏微分方程多重解的框架。通过将无序的共存解转换为规范序列，PF能够在单次自回归过程中生成结构化解集；对于有限解族可自动终止，而对于无界解族则施加物理残差约束。在非线性椭圆问题上，它能够在一次推理步骤中恢复所有解分支；在Gray-Scott系统上，它生成共存的图灵模式，其中包括参考数据中不存在且超出训练范围、但在物理上有效的状态。PF还可以在多稳态系统之间进行顺序微调，从而朝着用于解景观的通用基础模型发展。

full_list.title_en: Surrogate-Assisted Inverse Design and Temperature-Dependent Electrothermal Analysis of an All-Oxide Narrowband Thermophotovoltaic Emitter
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Surrogate-Assisted Inverse Design and Temperature-Dependent Electrothermal Analysis of an All-Oxide Narrowband Thermophotovoltaic Emitter
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.10252v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A narrowband emitter aligning with the bandgap of the underlying solar cell is essential for improving the spectral efficiency and thermal stability of thermophotovoltaic (TPV) systems. Emitters based on oxide materials present a promising solution to the optical and mechanical performance degradation of traditional emitters, which employ metal-dielectric structures that experience metal oxidation and structural deterioration at high temperatures. Here, we presented a surrogate-assisted inverse-design framework for a narrowband 1D grating emitter comprising ITO and Al2O3 layers on a sapphire substrate. We performed Bayesian optimization over the trained ExtraTrees surrogates on a penalty-augmented objective containing a peak-emission constraint (E_peak > 0.90) while minimizing the full width at half maximum (FWHM) and maximizing the fraction of emission concentrated within the selected peak-centered spectral band to acquire a high, narrowband peak emission. The surrogate model was trained using a dataset of emission spectra obtained from the finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) by systematically varying the layers' thicknesses and the structure's period as the input features, and the narrowband emission's figure of merit (FOM) ((E_peak), wavelength of peak emission (_peak), FWHM, in-band fraction (f_in) for determining the amount of emission outside the peak band, and concentration of peak emission near the peak) was used as the prediction target. The resulting set of predictions for the optimized structure was further validated using the FDTD method.

full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.09547v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Sample size determination for machine learning (ML) prediction models is challenging because conventional power analysis typically requires the predictor-outcome relationship and effect structure to be specified a priori. Nonlinear ML models learn complex prediction surfaces that do not admit straightforward analytical power calculations. We propose a framework that approximates nonlinear ML models with localized linear representations and estimates sample size requirements by evaluating statistical power across these local regions.

full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Reinforcement learning for Quantum Tiq-Taq-Toe
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2411.06429v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum Tiq-Taq-Toe is a well-known benchmark and playground for both quantum computing and machine learning. Despite its popularity, no reinforcement learning (RL) methods have been applied to Quantum Tiq-Taq-Toe. Although there has been some research on Quantum Chess this game is significantly more complex in terms of computation and analysis. Therefore, we study the combination of quantum computing and reinforcement learning in Quantum Tiq-Taq-Toe, which may serve as an accessible testbed for the integration of both fields. Quantum games are challenging to represent classically due to their inherent partial observability and the potential for exponential state complexity. In Quantum Tiq-Taq-Toe, states are observed through Measurement (a 3x3 matrix of state probabilities) and Move History (a 9x9 matrix of entanglement relations), making strategy complex as each move can collapse the quantum state.

full_list.summary: 该论文研究滑移铁电体中的隧穿电阻效应，发现层间滑移与铁电极化状态能够产生巨大的隧穿电阻变化。工作揭示了滑移铁电极化、层间堆垛和界面电子输运之间的强耦合，为非易失性隧穿器件提供了材料与物理基础。
full_list.focus_summary: 该论文研究滑移铁电体中的隧穿电阻效应，发现层间滑移与铁电极化状态能够产生巨大的隧穿电阻变化。工作揭示了滑移铁电极化、层间堆垛和界面电子输运之间的强耦合，为非易失性隧穿器件提供了材料与物理基础。
full_list.focus_relation: 与我们的二维滑移铁电、范德华材料、双层堆垛、界面电荷转移和量子输运方向直接对应。其隧穿电阻调控机制可与第一性原理电子结构、Wannier 输运及有效哈密顿量研究结合。
full_list.focus_suggestion: 建议进一步分析不同层间滑移路径、应变、层数和缺陷对势垒高度及隧穿电流的影响，并建立滑移坐标与隧穿电导之间的有效模型。还可探索滑移铁电与二维磁体或自旋轨道耦合材料构成的磁电隧道器件。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 二维滑移铁电、层间堆垛和畴壁对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 二维滑移铁电、层间堆垛和畴壁在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Giant tunneling electroresistance in sliding ferroelectrics》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Critical temperatures of two dimensional magnets beyond linear spin wave theory: application to CrI₃, MPS₃ (M=Ni, Mn, Fe) and CrSBr
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Critical temperatures of two dimensional magnets beyond linear spin wave theory: application to CrI₃, MPS₃ (M=Ni, Mn, Fe) and CrSBr
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2511.08426v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Magnetic anisotropy is crucial for sustaining long range magnetic order in two-dimensional materials (2D) and must be taken into account by any approximate scheme for calculating critical temperatures. While 2D ferromagnets have received significant attention with regard to predicting Curie temperatures, the treatment of 2D anti-ferromagnetism has largely been restricted to classical approaches, which typically underestimate Néel temperatures. The concept of anti-ferromagnetism can be regarded as a special case of single-Q magnetic order, and for such systems the critical temperature can be calculated from the magnon dispersion using either Holstein-Primakoff (HP) bosonization or Green's function-based Random Phase Approximation (RPA). Here, we study the effects of single-ion anisotropy in general single-Q systems in both the HP and RPA methods. In the case of RPA, we generalize the approach to include the Callen Decoupling (CD) correction, which has previously been shown to yield good agreement with experimental Curie temperatures for 2D ferromagnets. We compare the calculated critical temperatures of CrI₃ (uniaxial ferromagnet), MPS₃ (M=Ni, Mn, Fe) (uniaxial anti-ferromagnets) and CrSBr (triaxial ferromagnet) monolayers with experimental values and find that the Green's function-based methods are much more reliable than HP and that the CD decoupling appears to be more accurate than RPA if the single-ion anisotropy is large.
full_list.summary: 论文研究超越线性自旋波理论的二维磁体临界温度，系统考察单离子各向异性对一般单Q磁序的影响，并比较Holstein–Primakoff玻色化与随机相位近似方法。研究对象包括CrI3、Ni/Mn/Fe基MPS3和CrSBr，旨在更准确地预测二维铁磁体和反铁磁体的居里或尼尔温度。

full_list.title_en: Automated Generation of Commensurate Magnetic Structures based on Spin Space Groups and Graph Theory
full_list.title_zh: 基于自旋空间群与图论的公度磁结构自动生成
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.09679v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetic structures with symmetry constraints are candidates for energetically favorable configurations. Enumerating these structures is essential for identifying experimental observations and provides unbiased, linearly stable, and optimally sampled reference configurations for energy fitting when extracting spin interactions. We present SpinGraph, an automated workflow generating symmetry-distinct magnetic configurations. SpinGraph is not only compatible with the more general spin space groups, but also allows precise control of the prescribed single- or multi-Q states superposition. For finite groups, we enumerate compatible subgroups directly. For spin space groups with a continuous or special spin-only part, the finite component is enumerated first and then combined with the compatible exact spin-only constraints. These actions are translated into graph constraints in real or Fourier space. The symmetry of every generated structure is re-evaluated after construction. Finally, we integrate SpinGraph with the magnetic analysis code AMATIS to perform a thorough calculation for the spin interactions of the insulating monolayer CrI3. SpinGraph complements the last part of AMATIS and realizes the fully automated workflow for the spin Hamiltonian construction, which is essential for studying phase transitions, spin textures, magnons, and spin dynamics.
full_list.abstract_zh: 该工作提出SpinGraph自动化工作流，用于生成在对称性上不同的磁构型，并支持一般自旋空间群及指定单Q或多Q态叠加的精确控制。该方法将对称性操作转换为实空间或傅里叶空间中的图约束，并在构建后重新评估每个结构的对称性。作者将其与AMATIS结合，完成了绝缘单层CrI3自旋相互作用的自动化分析。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 具有对称性约束的磁结构是可能在能量上更有利的构型候选。枚举这些结构对于识别实验观测至关重要，并且在提取自旋相互作用进行能量拟合时，可提供无偏、线性稳定且得到最优采样的参考构型。我们提出SpinGraph，这是一种用于生成对称性不同的磁构型的自动化工作流。SpinGraph不仅兼容更一般的自旋空间群，而且允许精确控制所指定的单Q态或多Q态叠加。对于有限群，我们直接枚举相容的子群。对于具有连续或特殊纯自旋部分的自旋空间群，首先枚举有限部分，然后将其与相容的精确纯自旋约束结合。这些操作被转换为实空间或傅里叶空间中的图约束。每个生成结构的对称性都会在构建后重新评估。最后，我们将SpinGraph与磁学分析代码AMATIS集成，对绝缘单层CrI3的自旋相互作用进行了全面计算。SpinGraph补充了AMATIS的最后一部分，实现了自旋哈密顿量构建的全自动工作流，这对于研究相变、自旋纹理、磁振子和自旋动力学至关重要。
full_list.summary: 该工作提出SpinGraph自动化工作流，用于生成在对称性上不同的磁构型，并支持一般自旋空间群及指定单Q或多Q态叠加的精确控制。该方法将对称性操作转换为实空间或傅里叶空间中的图约束，并在构建后重新评估每个结构的对称性。作者将其与AMATIS结合，完成了绝缘单层CrI3自旋相互作用的自动化分析。

full_list.focus_suggestion: 建议重点阅读其自旋空间群枚举、连续自旋约束处理及与自旋哈密顿量拟合的接口。可进一步将该流程与主动学习、等变神经网络和高通量磁性材料筛选结合，研究自旋轨道耦合、Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用及多重波矢磁序。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：有效哈密顿量或机器学习哈密顿量，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《基于自旋空间群与图论的公度磁结构自动生成》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: A First-Principles Multiscale Framework for Topological Superconductivity
full_list.title_zh: 拓扑超导的第一性原理多尺度框架
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.10381v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A microscopic understanding of topological superconductivity (TSC) in real materials requires a materials-informed approach that integrates first-principles electronic structure, superconductivity, and topology within a unified computational framework. Here, we develop such an approach by combining density functional theory, Wannier-based low-energy Hamiltonians, Bogoliubov-de Gennes theory, and Matsubara Green's-function-based Chern number calculations performed directly on realistic multiorbital superconducting Hamiltonians. We apply this framework to bulk-like and monolayer FeTeSe and to FeSe/GaAs heterostructures, enabling a unified investigation of both intrinsic and proximity-induced topological superconductivity. We identify key electronic-structure ingredients that promote robust TSC, including Rashba-active states near the Fermi level, strong induced superconducting pairing, and substantial orbital hybridization between spin-orbit-active and superconducting sectors. Guided by these design principles, we predict multiple topological superconducting phases in Fe-based materials and demonstrate that FeSe/GaAs heterostructures are particularly promising, exhibiting topological transitions at experimentally accessible chemical potentials and low Zeeman fields. Complementing the theoretical predictions, we demonstrate the growth and structural characterization of FeSe/GaAs heterostructures, establishing the experimental feasibility of the proposed materials platform. Our results provide a quantitative route for engineering and screening candidate Majorana materials and heterostructures directly from realistic electronic structures and establish a foundation for future materials-by-design approaches to topological superconductivity.
full_list.abstract_zh: 该工作构建了一个将密度泛函理论、Wannier低能哈密顿量、Bogoliubov-de Gennes理论和基于Matsubara格林函数的陈数计算结合起来的拓扑超导计算框架。该框架被用于块体和单层FeTeSe以及FeSe/GaAs异质结构，识别出费米能级附近Rashba活性态、强诱导配对和轨道杂化等促进稳健拓扑超导的关键因素。研究预测FeSe/GaAs具有实验可及化学势和低塞曼场下的拓扑转变，并展示了该异质结构的生长与结构表征。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 对真实材料中拓扑超导性（TSC）的微观理解，需要一种材料信息驱动的方法，在统一的计算框架内整合第一性原理电子结构、超导性和拓扑性。本文通过结合密度泛函理论、基于Wannier的低能哈密顿量、Bogoliubov-de Gennes理论，以及直接在真实多轨道超导哈密顿量上进行的基于Matsubara格林函数的陈数计算，发展了这样一种方法。我们将该框架应用于块体类和单层FeTeSe，以及FeSe/GaAs异质结构，从而能够统一研究本征和近邻诱导的拓扑超导性。我们识别出促进稳健TSC的关键电子结构要素，包括费米能级附近的Rashba活性态、强的诱导超导配对，以及自旋轨道活性部分与超导部分之间显著的轨道杂化。在这些设计原则指导下，我们预测了铁基材料中的多个拓扑超导相，并表明FeSe/GaAs异质结构尤其具有前景，其在实验可及的化学势和低塞曼场下表现出拓扑转变。作为对理论预测的补充，我们展示了FeSe/GaAs异质结构的生长和结构表征，确立了所提出材料平台的实验可行性。我们的结果为直接从真实电子结构设计和筛选候选Majorana材料及异质结构提供了一条定量路径，并为未来面向拓扑超导的材料设计方法奠定了基础。
full_list.summary: 该工作构建了一个将密度泛函理论、Wannier低能哈密顿量、Bogoliubov-de Gennes理论和基于Matsubara格林函数的陈数计算结合起来的拓扑超导计算框架。该框架被用于块体和单层FeTeSe以及FeSe/GaAs异质结构，识别出费米能级附近Rashba活性态、强诱导配对和轨道杂化等促进稳健拓扑超导的关键因素。研究预测FeSe/GaAs具有实验可及化学势和低塞曼场下的拓扑转变，并展示了该异质结构的生长与结构表征。
full_list.focus_summary: 本文建立融合第一性原理电子结构、Wannier低能哈密顿量、Bogoliubov-de Gennes理论和基于Matsubara格林函数的陈数计算的拓扑超导多尺度框架。该框架应用于FeTeSe、单层FeSe及FeSe/GaAs异质结构，预测了由Rashba态、超导配对和轨道杂化共同促进的多种拓扑超导相。
full_list.focus_relation: 与我们的超导、拓扑材料、Wannier插值、有效或从头算哈密顿量、界面异质结构和自旋轨道耦合方向高度相关。其将真实材料第一性原理结果直接映射到超导拓扑模型的策略，可借鉴到磁性超导体、二维异质结和拓扑磁性材料设计中。
full_list.focus_suggestion: 建议进一步考察磁序、应变、缺陷和界面无序对拓扑超导相及马约拉纳边界态的影响，并结合自旋哈密顿量或自洽电子-声子耦合。也可阅读其Wannier化与拓扑不变量计算流程，评估在团队现有材料高通量筛选和机器学习哈密顿量中的应用。
full_list.method_point: 该文建立从DFT到Wannier低能模型、Bogoliubov-de Gennes方程及Matsubara格林函数陈数的多尺度流程，以判定拓扑超导而非仅凭能带反转推断。作者用于块体和单层FeTeSe及FeSe/GaAs异质结，先分辨费米能附近Rashba活性态与轨道杂化，再加入诱导配对和塞曼场求解BdG谱及拓扑不变量。框架指出FeSe/GaAs在实验可及化学势、较低塞曼场附近发生转变，并同时报告异质结构的生长和结构表征；可靠性取决于Wannier窗口、SOC、配对参数和界面电荷转移的收敛。
full_list.related_work: 该路线与团队已有Wannier、BdG、量子输运和高温超导筛选能力高度匹配，比只以DFT能带计算Z2指标更能处理超导配对、磁场和化学势依赖。Xin-Gao Gong及Ji-Hui Yang对FeSe电子-声子耦合、超导和异质界面的研究可直接提供输入物理；Hongjun Xiang对磁序和SOC对称性的分析则适用于确定允许的Rashba与Zeeman项。它与铁电界面调控也存在交叉：BaTiO3或HfO2极化可改变界面电场和Rashba项，但不能在未计算屏蔽、电荷转移和配对来源前宣称产生拓扑相。
full_list.implication: 可针对FeSe/BaTiO3、FeSe/HfO2或FeSe/GaAs建立含不同终止面和极化方向的界面超胞，以DFT+SOC弛豫并计算层分辨电荷、势阶和Rashba劈裂。用Wannier90构造Fe-d与界面相关轨道模型，按DFT或实验约束扫描化学势、诱导s波配对和面内外Zeeman场，采用Matsubara陈数与边缘谱双重判定相界。验证应包含不同Wannier投影和k网格收敛、极化翻转前后的可逆拓扑区间，以及与ARPES能带或STM零能边缘态的可观测特征对应。

full_list.title_en: Two-magnon response from light scattering in altermagnets
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Two-magnon response from light scattering in altermagnets
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.09287v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnetism is a recently established class of magnetic order that combines fully compensated moments with momentum-dependent spin splitting, yet identifying its spectroscopic fingerprints remains an open challenge. In this work, we investigate finite-momentum two-magnon excitations in a two-dimensional d-wave altermagnet by calculating the two-magnon light scattering intensity in different polarization channels. Using linear spin-wave theory and further incorporating the leading 1/S quantum corrections, we demonstrate that the characteristic magnon splitting of altermagnets shifts the upper edge of the two-magnon continuum and the corresponding spectral features to higher energy at boldsymbolX=(π,0) relative to the conventional antiferromagnet, by an amount linear in the exchange anisotropy |δ J₂|, while leaving the response at the Brillouin-zone center unchanged. Although magnon-magnon interactions strongly redistribute spectral weight toward lower energies, the energy scale associated with the high-energy momentum-selective reconstruction remains robust. The interactions additionally generate a pronounced low-energy two-peak structure that has no counterpart within linear spin-wave theory. At boldsymbolK=(π/2,π/2), we show that the interacting two-magnon resonance is twofold degenerate in the conventional antiferromagnetic phase, while a finite altermagnetic exchange anisotropy lifts this degeneracy, producing two peaks whose separation is linear in |δ J₂|. The characteristic energy scales underlying both features are intrinsic to the two-magnon sector rather than to a specific scattering operator. These findings highlight the potential of finite-momentum two-magnon spectroscopy for identifying altermagnetic order in insulating magnets and motivate momentum-resolved resonant inelastic x-ray scattering studies of candidate altermagnetic materials.
full_list.summary: 论文研究交替磁体中的有限动量双磁振子激发，并计算不同偏振通道下的光散射强度。结果表明，交替磁性导致双磁振子连续谱上边缘和相关光谱特征发生与交换各向异性成正比的高能移动，同时磁振子相互作用会重新分配低能谱重。

full_list.title_en: Semi-Dirac States and Quantum Linear Magnetoresistance in Helimagnetic Pnictide MnP
full_list.title_zh: 螺旋磁性磷族化合物MnP中的半狄拉克态与量子线性磁阻
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.09781v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large linear positive magnetoresistance (LPMR) in topological and magnetic materials remains a subject of intense debate, particularly in noncollinear spin systems where spin-dependent scattering complicates charge transport. Manganese phosphide (MnP), a helimagnetic binary pnictide with multiple field-induced magnetic transitions, provides a useful platform to investigate the interplay between complex magnetism and electronic topology. Here, we present a comprehensive experimental and theoretical investigation of phase-dependent magnetotransport in high-quality MnP single crystals. Hall measurements reveal an anomalous Hall effect dominated by skew scattering at high temperatures and a finite topological Hall effect in the noncollinear fan (FAN) and low-temperature screw (SCR) phases. At low temperatures, we observe a large, non-saturating LPMR reaching nearly 800 percent at 4 K and 15 T, with a pronounced linear field dependence in the field-polarized ferromagnetic (FM2) state. First-principles calculations reveal a strongly anisotropic semi-Dirac-like band at the Y point that progressively approaches the Fermi level from the SCR to FAN and FM2 states. Our analysis indicates that the resulting small Fermi pocket can access the extreme quantum-limit regime at experimentally accessible fields, providing a microscopic framework for the observed LPMR within Abrikosov's quantum magnetoresistance theory.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文对高质量MnP单晶中的相依赖磁输运进行了实验和理论研究。研究观察到低温下接近800%的非饱和线性正磁阻，并发现Y点附近存在强各向异性的半狄拉克型能带，该能带从螺旋相向扇形相和场极化铁磁相演化并逐渐接近费米能级。由此形成的小费米口袋可在实验可达磁场下进入极端量子极限，为观察到的线性磁阻提供了基于Abrikosov量子磁阻理论的微观解释。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 拓扑材料和磁性材料中的巨大线性正磁阻仍是一个受到广泛讨论的问题，尤其是在非共线自旋体系中，自旋依赖散射使电荷输运更加复杂。磷化锰（MnP）是一种具有螺旋磁性的二元磷族化合物，并存在多个由磁场诱导的磁性转变，为研究复杂磁性与电子拓扑之间的相互作用提供了有用平台。本文对高质量MnP单晶中的相依赖磁输运进行了全面的实验和理论研究。霍尔测量表明，在高温下反常霍尔效应主要由偏斜散射主导；在非共线扇形相（FAN）和低温螺旋相（SCR）中，则存在有限的拓扑霍尔效应。在低温下，研究观察到巨大且不饱和的线性正磁阻，在4 K和15 T条件下接近800%；在场极化铁磁相（FM2）中，磁阻表现出显著的线性场依赖关系。第一性原理计算揭示，在Y点存在一个强各向异性的类半狄拉克能带，该能带从SCR相向FAN相和FM2相演化时逐步接近费米能级。我们的分析表明，由此产生的小费米口袋可以在实验可达的磁场下进入极端量子极限，从而依据Abrikosov量子磁阻理论，为所观察到的线性正磁阻提供了微观框架。
full_list.summary: 本文对高质量MnP单晶中的相依赖磁输运进行了实验和理论研究。研究观察到低温下接近800%的非饱和线性正磁阻，并发现Y点附近存在强各向异性的半狄拉克型能带，该能带从螺旋相向扇形相和场极化铁磁相演化并逐渐接近费米能级。由此形成的小费米口袋可在实验可达磁场下进入极端量子极限，为观察到的线性磁阻提供了基于Abrikosov量子磁阻理论的微观解释。
full_list.focus_summary: 该工作结合高质量 MnP 单晶的磁输运实验与第一性原理计算，研究螺旋磁性、非共线磁结构和磁场诱导相变下的霍尔效应与线性磁阻。结果表明，MnP 中存在相依赖的反常霍尔和拓扑霍尔效应，并在低温下观察到接近 800% 的非饱和线性正磁阻，计算揭示了费米能级附近的强各向异性半狄拉克型能带。
full_list.focus_relation: 与我们的磁性材料、非共线磁性、电子结构计算、拓扑磁性和量子输运方向高度相关。其磁结构与能带拓扑耦合、反常/拓扑霍尔效应及磁阻机制可为自旋哈密顿量、磁性输运和磁性拓扑材料研究提供参考。
full_list.focus_suggestion: 可进一步结合 Wannier 插值、Boltzmann 输运和自旋相关散射模型，定量分解螺旋磁序对磁阻与霍尔响应的贡献。也可研究应变、载流子调控或缺陷对 MnP 半狄拉克特征及拓扑输运的影响。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：第一性原理标注与结构优化，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《螺旋磁性磷族化合物MnP中的半狄拉克态与量子线性磁阻》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

In this work, we advance the field by introducing the concept of surface altermagnetism (SAM), wherein altermagnetic spin polarization emerges at the surfaces of collinear antife… [Phys. Rev. Lett. 137, 116705] Published Thu Sep 10, 2026
full_list.abstract_zh: 该工作围绕“表面交错磁性”概念展开，旨在将交错磁性研究从磁性材料的体相自旋极化电子态拓展至表面现象。根据所提供的摘要片段，作者关注共线反铁磁材料表面出现的交错磁性自旋极化；具体理论、材料体系与结论需查阅原文。

full_list.summary: 该工作围绕“表面交错磁性”概念展开，旨在将交错磁性研究从磁性材料的体相自旋极化电子态拓展至表面现象。根据所提供的摘要片段，作者关注共线反铁磁材料表面出现的交错磁性自旋极化；具体理论、材料体系与结论需查阅原文。
full_list.focus_summary: 该工作提出表面交替磁性概念，指出共线反铁磁材料的表面可以产生交替磁性自旋极化。研究将交替磁性的关注点从体相自旋极化电子态扩展到表面电子结构和表面磁性现象。

full_list.title_en: WannierNLQG: A Julia package for nonlinear optical responses and quantum geometry from Wannier tight-binding models
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：WannierNLQG: A Julia package for nonlinear optical responses and quantum geometry from Wannier tight-binding models
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.10411v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nonlinear optical responses and quantum geometry are central to modern condensed matter physics and are deeply intertwined. We introduce WannierNLQG, an extensible Julia framework for computing nonlinear optical responses and quantum geometric quantities from Wannier tight-binding models. Its gauge-consistent, degeneracy-aware architecture accommodates perturbative responses at arbitrary order and additional quantum geometric quantities. The current release evaluates ordinary, spin, and photon-drag injection and shift currents, as Brillouin-zone integrals and on k slices. For shift current, a unified interface exposes four complementary formulations: the conventional method, projector trace, generalized Wilson loop, and a finite-momentum geometric loop, with the last three explicitly accommodating degenerate subspaces. The framework also provides k-resolved Berry curvature, quantum metric, their multipoles, and additional quantum geometric and mixed momentum-spin quantities. Experimental symmetry workflows additionally support symmetry-adapted Wannier construction, symmetrization of tight-binding models and real-space operators, and reduction of spatially uniform response integrals to irreducible k-point orbits and invariant tensor components. The documentation covers formula conventions, the TaskConfig interface, and auditable output formats, with GeS and bilayer MoS2 case studies illustrating method comparison, degeneracy handling, quantum geometric analysis, and photon-drag responses. Together, these capabilities enable first-principles calculations of nonlinear response and quantum geometry in realistic multiband materials, connecting quantum geometry with quantitative materials modeling for optoelectronic, spintronic, and photovoltaic applications.
full_list.summary: 该研究介绍了 WannierNLQG Julia 软件包，用于基于 Wannier 紧束缚模型计算非线性光学响应和量子几何性质。软件支持注入流、位移流、自旋响应、贝里曲率、量子度规及简并子空间下的规范一致计算。
full_list.focus_summary: 该研究介绍了 WannierNLQG Julia 软件包，用于基于 Wannier 紧束缚模型计算非线性光学响应和量子几何性质。软件支持注入流、位移流、自旋响应、贝里曲率、量子度规及简并子空间下的规范一致计算。
full_list.focus_relation: 与团队的 Wannier 计算、电子结构、非线性光学响应、拓扑材料和自旋相关输运研究高度相关。其对简并能带、量子几何和对称性约束的处理可补充团队现有的电子结构与光学性质计算工具链。
full_list.focus_suggestion: 可评估该软件在二维铁电体、磁性拓扑材料、交替磁性材料和范德华异质结构中的适用性。进一步结合第一性原理和机器学习哈密顿量，可开展应变、层间堆垛或磁序调控下的非线性光学响应研究。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：第一性原理标注与结构优化, Wannier 插值和有效电子模型，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《WannierNLQG: A Julia package for nonlinear optical responses and quantum geometry from Wannier tight-binding models》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Nonlinear Topological Orbital Responses of Antiferromagnetic Skyrmions
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Nonlinear Topological Orbital Responses of Antiferromagnetic Skyrmions
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.08022v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Antiferromagnetic skyrmions evade the skyrmion Hall effect, but compensation suppresses their conventional topological charge Hall signal. We predict a semiclassical nonlinear topological orbital response of an isolated skyrmion in a PT-symmetric hexagonal antiferromagnet without spin-orbit coupling. In the diffusive, weak-emergent-field regime, the spin-dependent emergent Lorentz force reshapes the carrier distribution, generating a local orbital Hall-current correction and a local orbital accumulation, both quadratic in the applied electric field. The current correction requires spin-asymmetric longitudinal scattering, whereas the accumulation survives spin-symmetric scattering. When the spin-diffusion length greatly exceeds the strip width, the current correction persists while the accumulation approaches zero. Both signals are even under electric-field reversal, odd under reversal of the skyrmion topological charge Q, and helicity independent within this model. These symmetries enable rectified detection and distinguish this mechanism from the Q-even quantum-regime topological orbital Hall effect.

full_list.title_en: Observation of Magnetic-Anisotropy Crossover and High-Temperature Skyrmions in the Dirac Magnet Fe3Ge with a Distorted Kagome Lattice
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Observation of Magnetic-Anisotropy Crossover and High-Temperature Skyrmions in the Dirac Magnet Fe3Ge with a Distorted Kagome Lattice
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.10081v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Topological materials that simultaneously host robust high-temperature skyrmions and nontrivial electronic band structures have attracted tremendous interest owing to their distinctive advantages for both fundamental research and prospective technological applications. Here, we report the observation of robust skyrmions in the Dirac kagome magnet Fe3Ge, which exhibits a high Curie temperature of ~ 650 K. At room temperature, Fe3Ge shows a large intrinsic anomalous Hall conductivity of ~ 380 Ω-1cm-1, originating from its nontrivial electronic band topology. Systematic magnetization measurements reveal a spin reorientation transition at ~ 375 K, indicating a crossover from easy-plane to easy-axis magnetic anisotropy. Below the spin reorientation temperature, a large topological Hall effect is observed, arising from microscopic noncoplanar spin structures. Lorentz transmission electron microscopy shows that mesoscopic skyrmions are stabilized in the easy-axis magnetic anisotropy regime and persist over an exceptionally wide temperature window of 375-650 K, far exceeding that of most previously reported skyrmion-hosting materials. These results establish Fe3Ge as a promising platform for exploring diverse topological properties, with strong potential for advancing future high-temperature spintronic applications, ranging from next-generation information storage to logic computing devices.
full_list.summary: 该实验工作在畸变Kagome晶格狄拉克磁体Fe3Ge中观察到高温稳定斯格明子、显著反常霍尔效应和拓扑霍尔效应。材料在约375 K发生由易面到易轴的磁各向异性重取向，斯格明子在易轴区间内可从375 K稳定至约650 K。

full_list.title_en: Record-Breaking Elemental Superconductivity in Tetralayer Kagome Borophene
full_list.title_zh: 四层卡戈梅硼烯中的创纪录元素超导性
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.09730v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Superconductivity above the liquid-nitrogen temperature remains rare in two-dimensional elemental crystals, where strong covalent bonding often yields high phonon frequencies but insufficient electron-phonon coupling. Here, using first-principles calculations and fully anisotropic Migdal-Eliashberg theory, we predict tetralayer kagome borophene (TKB) stabilized by ABAB covalent stacking, as a liquid-nitrogen-temperature elemental superconductor. With a predicted critical temperature of 102 K, TKB sets a record-high value among previously reported elemental superconductors. Unlike known high-Tc boron-based superconductors dominated by in-plane sigma-bonding states and high-frequency in-plane B-B stretching modes, TKB realizes an out-of-plane s-pz-bonding-mediated pairing mechanism, in which interlayer s-pz bonding states at the Fermi level are strongly coupled to low-frequency out-of-plane vibrations of boron atoms. These results reveal a distinct out-of-plane pairing channel in multilayer borophene and establish covalent stacking engineering as a potential route for high-Tc superconductivity in two-dimensional materials.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文通过第一性原理计算和完全各向异性的Migdal-Eliashberg理论，预测了由ABAB共价堆垛稳定的四层卡戈梅硼烯。该材料的预测临界温度达到102 K，创下已报道元素超导体中的最高值。其超导配对由费米能级附近的层间s-pz成键态与硼原子的低频面外振动强耦合所驱动，为二维材料实现高温超导提供了新的面外配对机制。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 在二维元素晶体中，高于液氮温度的超导性仍然十分罕见，因为强共价键通常能够产生较高的声子频率，却无法提供足够强的电子-声子耦合。本文利用第一性原理计算和完全各向异性的Migdal-Eliashberg理论，预测了由ABAB共价堆垛稳定的四层卡戈梅硼烯，并指出其是一种工作于液氮温度范围的元素超导体。其预测临界温度为102 K，在此前报道的元素超导体中创下最高值。不同于已知的高临界温度含硼超导体主要由面内σ成键态和高频面内B-B伸缩振动主导，四层卡戈梅硼烯实现了一种由面外s-pz成键介导的配对机制，其中费米能级处的层间s-pz成键态与硼原子的低频面外振动发生强耦合。这些结果揭示了多层硼烯中一种独特的面外配对通道，并表明共价堆垛工程可能成为在二维材料中实现高临界温度超导性的途径。
full_list.summary: 本文通过第一性原理计算和完全各向异性的Migdal-Eliashberg理论，预测了由ABAB共价堆垛稳定的四层卡戈梅硼烯。该材料的预测临界温度达到102 K，创下已报道元素超导体中的最高值。其超导配对由费米能级附近的层间s-pz成键态与硼原子的低频面外振动强耦合所驱动，为二维材料实现高温超导提供了新的面外配对机制。
full_list.focus_summary: 该工作利用第一性原理计算和全各向异性Migdal-Eliashberg理论，预测四层堆垛kagome硼烯具有约102 K的高临界温度。研究指出层间s-pz成键态与低频面外振动之间的强电子-声子耦合，是其高温超导的主要来源。
full_list.focus_relation: 与我们的二维材料、超导、电子-声子耦合和第一性原理计算方向直接相关。其层间堆垛工程和面外振动配对机制可为二维超导材料设计及声子重整化研究提供参考。
full_list.focus_suggestion: 可进一步检验该结构的动力学和热稳定性，并研究应变、载流子掺杂、磁性或衬底效应对超导转变温度的影响。也可结合机器学习势开展大尺度有限温度结构稳定性模拟。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入非绝热分子动力学、电子—声子耦合、Wannier/GW-BSE 和载流子输运。从摘要能确认的线索包括：第一性原理标注与结构优化, 电子—声子耦合与输运，以及声子、有限温度和输运性质, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“先用高精度电子结构和声子/电子—声子矩阵元建立小规模基准，再训练可迁移 Hamiltonian 或 ML 势，最后在长时间尺度非绝热 MD、输运或界面电荷转移中验证”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：非绝热分子动力学、电子—声子耦合、Wannier/GW-BSE 和载流子输运已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到卤化物钙钛矿、二维半导体、FeSe、光电界面和能源材料。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注声子、有限温度和输运性质, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。

full_list.title_en: A Structural Map of Potential Correlated Electron Molecular Orbital Materials
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：A Structural Map of Potential Correlated Electron Molecular Orbital Materials
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2601.04460v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Correlated electron molecular orbital (CEMO) materials host emergent electronic states built from molecular orbitals localized over clusters of transition metal ions in a solid, yet have historically been discovered sporadically and generally been treated as isolated case studies. Here, we present criteria and tools to classify and analyze these materials, provide a database of identified materials with cluster-specific symmetry analysis, including cluster point groups, effective cluster sublattice dimensionality. Our electronic structure analysis shows that narrow bands in cluster materials can arise either from relatively isolated cluster molecular orbitals or from a mixed mechanism in which cluster localization coexists with frustrated-lattice flat-band topology. We discuss how CEMO properties do not arise from metal clusters in a solid alone: rather they depend on electron count, symmetry, frustration and correlation strength. By integrating cluster classification with flat-band lattice topology and electrochemistry-relevant information, we provide further relevant information to multiple scientific communities. Applying this approach in a high-throughput screen of 34,548 compounds yields potential 2,627 stable or metastable CEMO compounds with isolated cluster motifs. The accompanying open dataset, Cluster Finder software, and interactive web platform enable systematic exploration of cluster-containing electronic solid state materials and establish a starting point for discovering a new class of correlated quantum materials with a wide array of properties.
full_list.summary: 论文建立了关联电子分子轨道材料的结构分类、分析工具和材料数据库，并结合团簇点群、有效子晶格维数、平带拓扑和电子结构分析揭示其形成机制。研究指出，窄能带来源既可能是局域团簇分子轨道，也可能是团簇局域化与受挫晶格平带拓扑的共同作用。

full_list.title_en: Finite-Temperature Flat-Band Ferromagnetism in the Kagome Hubbard Model
full_list.title_zh: Kagome Hubbard模型中的有限温度平带铁磁性
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.09289v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Kagome metals exhibit a rich interplay of topology, electronic correlations, and lattice dynamics. Recent discoveries of Kagome materials with a flat band near the Fermi level have revealed a variety of correlated electronic phases. However, elucidating their microscopic origin remains challenging, as realistic descriptions require accounting for multiple orbitals and competing interactions on an equal footing. To disentangle correlation effects from material-specific details and identify the essential physics of the flat-band regime, we study the single-orbital Kagome-Hubbard model at flat-band fillings using dynamical mean-field theory. We find strong signatures of flat-band ferromagnetism, consistent with exact and mean-field ground-state results. Moreover, we uncover an unconventional quasi-ordered phase in which a partially filled spin-polarized flat band pinned at the Fermi level gives rise to persistent local spin fluctuations down to zero temperature, in striking contrast to the classical behavior expected for a conventional ferromagnet. Our results demonstrate that these anomalous fluctuations are an intrinsic consequence of the flat-band degeneracy and establish a minimal framework for understanding correlation effects in flat-band Kagome systems.
full_list.abstract_zh: Kagome金属中的平带靠近费米能级时可产生丰富的关联电子相，但其微观机制仍不清楚。该研究利用动力学平均场理论考察平带填充下的单轨道Kagome-Hubbard模型，发现了与既有基态结果一致的强平带铁磁性证据。研究还揭示了一种非常规准有序相：部分填充且自旋极化的平带被钉扎于费米能级，在零温附近仍保持局域自旋涨落。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: Kagome金属展现出拓扑性、电子关联和晶格动力学之间丰富的相互作用。近期在费米能级附近具有平带的Kagome材料的发现，揭示了多种关联电子相。然而，阐明这些相的微观起源仍具挑战性，因为对真实材料的描述需要以同等地位考虑多个轨道和相互竞争的相互作用。为将关联效应与材料特定细节区分开来，并识别平带区域的本质物理，我们利用动力学平均场理论研究了平带填充下的单轨道Kagome-Hubbard模型。我们发现了强烈的平带铁磁性迹象，这与精确和平均场的基态结果一致。此外，我们揭示了一种非常规准有序相，其中一个部分填充、被钉扎在费米能级的自旋极化平带导致持续存在的局域自旋涨落，并一直延续至零温；这与传统铁磁体所预期的经典行为形成鲜明对比。我们的结果表明，这些反常涨落是平带简并性的内禀结果，并为理解平带Kagome体系中的关联效应建立了一个最简框架。
full_list.summary: Kagome金属中的平带靠近费米能级时可产生丰富的关联电子相，但其微观机制仍不清楚。该研究利用动力学平均场理论考察平带填充下的单轨道Kagome-Hubbard模型，发现了与既有基态结果一致的强平带铁磁性证据。研究还揭示了一种非常规准有序相：部分填充且自旋极化的平带被钉扎于费米能级，在零温附近仍保持局域自旋涨落。
full_list.focus_summary: 该工作利用动力学平均场理论研究平带填充附近的单轨道Kagome-Hubbard模型，发现了与平带铁磁性一致的强磁性特征。作者还识别出一种非常规准有序态：自旋极化平带钉扎于费米能级时，局域自旋涨落可持续至零温。

full_list.focus_suggestion: 建议比较该模型与实际Kagome材料中多轨道、晶格畸变、自旋轨道耦合及电子-声子耦合的影响。可从第一性原理和Wannier化出发构建材料特异的Hubbard或自旋模型，再结合DMFT、蒙特卡洛或机器学习哈密顿量研究有限温度磁序。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
