full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Ferromagnetic resonance modulation in topological materials with bulk-boundary coexistence》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: First-principles investigation of structural, mechanical, vibrational, thermal, electronic and optical properties of Na3Bi: a topological Dirac semimetal
full_list.title_zh: Na3Bi结构、力学、振动、热学、电子与光学性质的第一性原理研究：一种拓扑狄拉克半金属
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.09720v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Exploring the properties of topological materials has remained an active area of research in condensed matter physics for the past few decades. Here, we present a first-principles investigation of the structural, elasto-mechanical, thermal, electronic, and optical properties of Na3Bi, one of the earliest discovered topological Dirac semimetals, using density functional theory. The hexagonal phase of Na3Bi is found to be both mechanically and dynamically stable, exhibiting moderate elastic anisotropy with a universal anisotropy index of 0.832. The compound displays a moderate machinability index of 2.386 alongside a low hardness value of 2.005, consistent with its predominantly brittle, covalently bonded character accompanied by a slight metallic contribution. Its comparatively low Debye temperature of 181.39K points to a mechanically soft lattice with loosely bound atoms. Electronic structure calculations confirm semimetallic behavior, with well-defined Dirac points pinned at the Fermi level and a Fermi surface composed of point-like pockets. Optical analysis across a wide spectral range reveals non-selective, moderate reflectivity of 40 to 45% and, in the visible region, an unusually high refractive index reaching between 2 and 4.5. Na3Bi is additionally found to be an efficient absorber of ultraviolet radiation. Together, these findings establish a comprehensive baseline for the mechanical, thermal, and optical behavior of hexagonal Na3Bi and point to its potential relevance for acoustic damping, UV-sensing, and optoelectronic applications
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文基于密度泛函理论，系统研究了Na3Bi六方相的结构、弹性力学、热学、电子和光学性质。结果表明，Na3Bi具有机械和动力学稳定性，费米能级处存在清晰的狄拉克点，并表现出中等反射率、高可见光折射率和优良的紫外吸收能力。其性质表明，该材料在声学阻尼、紫外传感和光电器件领域具有潜在应用价值。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 在过去几十年中，拓扑材料性质的探索一直是凝聚态物理学中活跃的研究领域。本文利用密度泛函理论，对Na3Bi这一最早发现的拓扑狄拉克半金属之一的结构、弹性力学、热学、电子和光学性质进行了第一性原理研究。研究发现，Na3Bi的六方相在机械和动力学上均稳定，并表现出中等程度的弹性各向异性，其普适各向异性指数为0.832。该化合物的可加工性指数为2.386，属于中等水平；硬度值较低，为2.005，这与其以脆性、共价键合特征为主并伴有轻微金属性贡献的性质相一致。其相对较低的德拜温度为181.39 K，表明该材料晶格较软，原子之间的束缚较弱。电子结构计算证实其具有半金属性，在费米能级处存在定义清晰的狄拉克点，且费米面由点状口袋构成。在宽广的光谱范围内进行的光学分析表明，该材料具有40%至45%的非选择性中等反射率；在可见光区域，其折射率异常高，可达到2至4.5。研究还发现，Na3Bi能够有效吸收紫外辐射。总体而言，这些结果为六方Na3Bi的力学、热学和光学行为建立了全面基线，并指出其在声学阻尼、紫外传感和光电器件应用中的潜在价值。
full_list.summary: 本文基于密度泛函理论，系统研究了Na3Bi六方相的结构、弹性力学、热学、电子和光学性质。结果表明，Na3Bi具有机械和动力学稳定性，费米能级处存在清晰的狄拉克点，并表现出中等反射率、高可见光折射率和优良的紫外吸收能力。其性质表明，该材料在声学阻尼、紫外传感和光电器件领域具有潜在应用价值。
full_list.focus_summary: 该工作采用密度泛函理论系统计算Na3Bi拓扑狄拉克半金属的结构、力学、声子、热学、电子和光学性质。结果确认其六方相具有力学和动力学稳定性、较软晶格及费米能级附近的狄拉克点，并给出宽光谱范围内的光学响应。
full_list.focus_relation: 与团队的第一性原理计算、拓扑材料、电子结构和光学性质研究相关，但工作以常规材料性质表征为主。其结果可作为开展拓扑材料光电响应、应变调控和输运研究的基础数据。
full_list.focus_suggestion: 可结合Wannier插值进一步计算贝里曲率、表面态和量子输运，并考察应变、缺陷或异质结对狄拉克态及光学选择定则的调控。若关注激发态性质，可补充GW-BSE和电子-声子耦合计算。
full_list.method_point: 该文以第一性原理系统计算六方Na3Bi的结构、弹性、声子、热学、电子和光学性质，并以费米能附近的狄拉克点识别其拓扑狄拉克半金属性。计算链条通常包括几何优化后求应力响应和声子色散以检验机械及动力学稳定性，再由电子能带和介电函数导出反射率、折射率和吸收谱。摘要报告中等反射率、较高可见光折射率和紫外吸收，但未给出交换相关泛函、SOC处理、声子超胞或光学展宽，故对狄拉克节点位置和光谱强度的定量结论需以含SOC高精度复算确认。
full_list.related_work: 此类完整性质图谱与拓扑半金属的常规DFT筛选相呼应，但其方法本身没有机器学习环节，属于可为ML哈密顿量或高通量性质模型提供标签的基础工作。它和Xin-Gao Gong的Wannier量子输运、Ji-Hui Yang的二维材料光学与载流子输运方向相接，也可与Hongyu Yu的机器学习Kohn-Sham哈密顿量结合以加速SOC能带。Na3Bi不同于CrI3、CrSBr等磁性体系，不含自发磁序；若讨论磁掺杂或铁电界面诱导拓扑转变，必须额外计算交换场、结构稳定性和对称性破缺。
full_list.implication: 可用Na3Bi作为含强SOC拓扑材料的ML哈密顿量基准：在体相、应变、层数、表面和缺陷构型上生成含SOC的DFT数据，并以能带、速度矩阵和轨道投影监督等变模型。由模型快速筛选应变和电场条件，再对候选点执行Wannier插值，计算Wilson环、表面谱、Berry曲率及玻尔兹曼输运。实验相关验证可对接ARPES狄拉克点位置、红外或椭偏光谱和霍尔迁移率；同时以DFT声子和有限温MD排除仅电子上拓扑、结构上不稳定的候选状态。

full_list.title_en: Evidence of Haldane-Chain Physics in an Fe-Dehydroindigo Coordination Polymer
full_list.title_zh: 铁-脱氢靛蓝配位聚合物中Haldane链物理的证据
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.06684v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate whether an Fe--dehydroindigo coordination polymer can support Haldane-chain physics in its intrinsic, substrate-free limit. Spin-orbit-coupled density-functional-theory calculations and magnetic energy mapping yield a nearly isotropic antiferromagnetic coupling, together with much weaker single-ion anisotropy. Using these parameters, exact diagonalization and density-matrix renormalization group calculations give a nondegenerate ground state separated from the lowest triplet-derived excitations by a gap of about 13--14~meV, on the scale expected for the spin-1 Haldane gap. The anisotropy produces only a small splitting of the low-energy modes. The dynamical spin structure factor places the lowest spectral weight near the antiferromagnetic wave vector q=π. These results identify the isolated cis-dehydroindigo chain as a material-specific coordination-polymer platform whose microscopic interactions place it in a gapped regime consistent with Haldane-chain physics.
full_list.abstract_zh: 该研究考察铁-脱氢靛蓝自旋交叉配位聚合物在本征无衬底极限下是否支持Haldane链物理。自旋轨道耦合密度泛函理论、磁能映射、精确对角化和密度矩阵重整化群计算显示，该体系具有近各向同性反铁磁耦合和约13–14 meV的能隙，符合自旋1 Haldane能隙的预期尺度。动态自旋结构因子的低能谱权重位于反铁磁波矢附近，支持其作为Haldane链物理材料平台的判定。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2609.06684v1；通告类型：新稿。摘要：我们研究一种铁-脱氢靛蓝自旋交叉配位聚合物在其本征、无衬底极限下是否能够支持Haldane链物理。自旋轨道耦合密度泛函理论计算和磁能映射给出了近乎各向同性的反铁磁耦合J_H = 32.206 meV，同时单离子各向异性要弱得多。利用这些参数，精确对角化和密度矩阵重整化群计算得到一个非简并基态，该基态与最低的三重态衍生激发之间相隔约13–14 meV的能隙，其尺度符合自旋1 Haldane能隙的预期。各向异性仅导致低能模发生很小的劈裂。动态自旋结构因子将最低谱权重定位在反铁磁波矢q = π附近。这些结果将孤立的顺式脱氢靛蓝链识别为一个具有材料特异性的配位聚合物平台，其微观相互作用使其处于与Haldane链物理一致的有能隙区域。
full_list.summary: 该研究考察铁-脱氢靛蓝自旋交叉配位聚合物在本征无衬底极限下是否支持Haldane链物理。自旋轨道耦合密度泛函理论、磁能映射、精确对角化和密度矩阵重整化群计算显示，该体系具有近各向同性反铁磁耦合和约13–14 meV的能隙，符合自旋1 Haldane能隙的预期尺度。动态自旋结构因子的低能谱权重位于反铁磁波矢附近，支持其作为Haldane链物理材料平台的判定。
full_list.method_point: 该研究以自旋轨道耦合DFT计算铁-脱氢靛蓝配位聚合物的磁构型能量，再经磁能映射得到近各向同性反铁磁交换参数，并用精确对角化和密度矩阵重整化群求一维自旋模型。计算得到约13至14 meV的能隙，动态自旋结构因子低能权重集中在反铁磁波矢，与整数自旋1链的Haldane能隙相符。方法的判别力来自同时比较基态能隙和动量分辨激发谱，而非把反铁磁交换本身等同于Haldane相；基底、有限链长和各向异性仍是实验实现中的关键扰动。
full_list.related_work: 它对应从DFT到自旋哈密顿量再到多体求解的标准多尺度磁性路线，与Hongjun Xiang的交换、Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用和自旋动力学，以及Hongyu Yu的自旋-晶格耦合建模直接一致。相对于CrI3、CrSBr等二维局域磁体，该体系的核心是配位聚合物中的准一维S=1拓扑量子磁性，低维涨落不能由经典蒙特卡洛替代。团队在非共线磁性和SOC-DFT方面的经验可用于检验单离子各向异性、链间交换及DMI是否破坏受保护的Haldane能隙。
full_list.implication: 可按DFT+U+SOC对该聚合物及配体、金属替换体系计算多组共线和非共线磁态，采用能量映射与受约束自旋方法同时拟合链内外J、单离子D、交换各向异性和DMI。将参数输入有限温DMRG或张量网络，计算不同链长、磁场和应变下的能隙、边缘自旋与动态结构因子；MLIP可用于采样热振动构型并拟合J对键长和扭角的依赖。验证需以中子散射或RIXS的S(q,w)、磁化率及磁场闭隙行为为目标，并通过基底吸附DFT量化链间耦合是否仍低于Haldane能隙。

full_list.title_en: Superfluidity in active quantum flocks
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Superfluidity in active quantum flocks
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.06515v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Active quantum matter has very recently emerged at the intersection between bio- and quantum many-body physics, combining the self-organization of living systems with the coherence of the quantum world. Active quantum systems have been shown to exhibit flocking - a collective phenomenon with no precedent in equilibrium quantum physics. In this work we uncover an unexpected layer of quantum order in active quantum flocks: they can become superfluid. We show that, in addition to the symmetry breaking associated with their directed motion, these flocks can also break an additional U(1) symmetry, giving rise to off-diagonal long-range order. For a microscopic model of active hard-core bosons governed by Lindblad dynamics, we derive an effective long-wavelength description of the single-particle density matrix and demonstrate that the flocking phase develops an instability toward off-diagonal long-range order characteristic of superfluid behavior. Our findings reveal active quantum matter as a promising research direction for discovering exotic nonequilibrium phases of quantum matter.

full_list.title_en: A Block Tensor Train Burer-Monteiro Framework for Low-Rank Quantum State Tomography
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：A Block Tensor Train Burer-Monteiro Framework for Low-Rank Quantum State Tomography
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.09457v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum state tomography is a fundamental technique for estimating the state of a quantum system from measured data and plays a crucial role in evaluating the performance of quantum devices. However, standard estimation methods become computationally prohibitive as the system size increases due to the exponential growth of the density matrix, describing a quantum state, with the number of qubits. We propose a low-rank tensor-network framework for mixed-state quantum state tomography based on a block tensor train (Block-TT) factorization. Specifically, the density matrix is represented as the contraction of a Block-TT with its Hermitian transpose, yielding a TT analogue of the Burer-Monteiro factorization. This parameterization guarantees Hermiticity and positive semidefiniteness by construction while compressing the number of optimization variables from exponential to linear in the number of qubits. Building on this representation, we develop single-site and two-site density matrix renormalization group (DMRG) algorithms for estimating quantum states from compressed measurements. The resulting methods operate directly on the compressed parameterization, support adaptive rank refinement, and exploit efficient tensor-network contractions for expectation-value evaluation. The framework is applicable to a broad class of low-rank quantum states, including pure states, nearly pure states, and ground states that admit accurate tensor-network approximations. Numerical experiments demonstrate accurate state reconstruction from limited measurements together with substantial reductions in memory requirements and computational cost compared with conventional low-rank tomography methods.

full_list.title_en: Apparent Zero-Momentum Signals from Magnon--Magnon Interference in Near-Field Spin-Wave Imaging
full_list.title_zh: 近场自旋波成像中由磁振子-磁振子干涉产生的表观零动量信号
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.09922v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spatially resolved measurements of coherent waves are commonly read as direct maps of the underlying eigenmode spectrum. We show that this interpretation fails in near-field imaging of multimode spin-wave transport. Scanning nitrogen-vacancy magnetometry of yttrium iron garnet reveals pronounced apparent low-wave-vector signals at frequencies for which no propagating spin-wave mode exists. By tuning the probe-sample distance and modeling the anisotropic near-field response, we identify their origin as coherent mixing between directly excited Damon-Eshbach waves and defect- or transducer-scattered spin waves: the measured signal acquires spatial Fourier components at the difference wave vector kₑₓc-kₛcₐₜ, which can vanish even though both constituent waves carry finite momentum. These results establish that near-field spectra of coherent excitations are interferometric field spectra rather than eigenmode maps, providing both a caution and a framework for identifying scattering processes in nanoscale magnonic devices.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文表明，在多模自旋波输运的近场成像中，空间分辨测量结果并不一定直接对应底层本征模谱。利用扫描氮-空位磁力计，研究发现某些频率下存在明显的表观低波矢信号，尽管这些频率没有传播自旋波模。该信号源于直接激发的Damon-Eshbach波与缺陷或换能器散射自旋波之间的相干混合，说明近场谱本质上是干涉场谱而非本征模图谱。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 对相干波进行空间分辨测量时，通常会将测量结果解读为底层本征模谱的直接映射。本文表明，在多模自旋波输运的近场成像中，这种解读并不成立。对钇铁石榴石进行扫描氮-空位磁力测量发现，在某些不存在传播自旋波模的频率处，仍然出现明显的表观低波矢信号。通过调节探针与样品之间的距离并对各向异性的近场响应进行建模，研究确定这些信号源于直接激发的Damon-Eshbach波与缺陷或换能器散射的自旋波之间的相干混合：测量信号会获得位于差分波矢k_exc-k_scat处的空间傅里叶分量，即使组成干涉的两列波都携带有限动量，该差分波矢仍可能为零。这些结果表明，相干激发的近场谱是干涉场谱，而不是本征模图谱；同时，这项工作也为识别纳米尺度磁振子器件中的散射过程提供了警示和分析框架。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。

full_list.title_en: Constrained Optimization of Higher-Order Cluster-Expansion Hamiltonians for Alloys Using Simulated Bifurcation
full_list.title_zh: 利用模拟分岔对合金高阶团簇展开哈密顿量进行约束优化
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.10310v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Identifying ground-state and low-energy atomic configurations is a central problem in alloy design. The cluster-expansion (CE) method represents configurational energetics on a fixed lattice as an effective Hamiltonian; for binary alloys, higher-order CE models become polynomial Ising Hamiltonians. Using Au-Cu as a model binary alloy, we formulate cubic and quartic cluster-expansion Hamiltonians as penalty-augmented polynomial unconstrained binary optimization (PUBO) problems under fixed-composition constraints. We optimize these PUBO problems using SQBM+, a simulated-bifurcation-based solver that can treat higher-order polynomial binary objectives directly. This direct PUBO treatment avoids the need to construct an explicit quadratic reformulation with auxiliary variables. Composition constraints are imposed through quadratic penalty terms, whose weights are estimated from derivative coefficients of the continuous relaxation of the CE objective. Benchmark calculations for systems up to 2048 atoms show that SQBM+ robustly obtains low-energy feasible configurations for cubic CE models and remains effective for many quartic instances. Formation-energy convex hulls constructed from the optimized configurations recover the CuAu and Cu3Au ordering trends and reveal finite-size effects at off-stoichiometric compositions. These results demonstrate simulated bifurcation as a practical route to constrained higher-order CE optimization for alloy configuration search.
full_list.abstract_zh: 寻找基态和低能原子构型是合金设计中的核心问题。该研究以Au-Cu二元合金为例，将三阶和四阶团簇展开哈密顿量在固定成分约束下表述为带惩罚项的多项式无约束二元优化问题，并使用SQBM+求解。计算表明，该方法能够在最大2048原子的体系中稳健获得低能可行构型，并恢复CuAu和Cu3Au的有序化趋势。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 识别基态和低能原子构型是合金设计中的一个核心问题。团簇展开（CE）方法将固定晶格上的构型能量学表示为有效哈密顿量；对于二元合金，高阶CE模型变为多项式Ising哈密顿量。我们以Au-Cu为模型二元合金，将三阶和四阶团簇展开哈密顿量在固定成分约束下表述为带惩罚项的多项式无约束二元优化（PUBO）问题。我们使用SQBM+对这些PUBO问题进行优化，SQBM+是一种基于模拟分岔的求解器，能够直接处理高阶多项式二元目标函数。这种直接的PUBO处理避免了利用辅助变量构建显式二次重构的需求。成分约束通过二次惩罚项施加，其权重由CE目标函数连续松弛的导数系数估计。针对最多2048个原子的体系进行的基准计算表明，SQBM+能够稳健地获得三阶CE模型的低能可行构型，并且对许多四阶实例仍然有效。根据优化构型构建的形成能凸包恢复了CuAu和Cu3Au的有序化趋势，并揭示了非化学计量成分下的有限尺寸效应。这些结果表明，模拟分岔是进行受约束高阶CE优化以搜索合金构型的一条实用途径。

full_list.title_en: Reconfigurable field-free spin Hall nano-oscillators enabled by crystallographic anisotropy in epitaxial Co/Pt
full_list.title_zh: 由外延Co/Pt中的晶体学各向异性实现的可重构无场自旋霍尔纳米振荡器
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.10131v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spin Hall nano-oscillators (SHNOs) are nanoscale microwave sources for wireless communication, neuromorphic computing and oscillator-based Ising machines, but conventional devices require a global magnetic bias. Here we replace this bias through crystallographic anisotropy in epitaxial Co/Pt. Growth of hcp Co with its c-axis in the film plane produces an anisotropy field of about 0.36 T and enables field-free auto-oscillations above 10 GHz in nanoconstriction SHNOs. The active current polarity is selected by the remanent magnetization, providing nonvolatile reconfiguration of the oscillation state. Micro-focused Brillouin light scattering confirms that the nonlinear response is confined to the nanoconstriction region. Lithographic control of the angle between the current and anisotropy axes tunes the excitation threshold and drives two spectral branches from separated modes to a dominant single branch, consistent with mutual synchronization. These results establish epitaxial crystallographic anisotropy as a route to reconfigurable field-free spintronic oscillators and oscillator networks.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文利用外延Co/Pt中的晶体学各向异性取代传统的全局磁偏置，实现了无外场自旋霍尔纳米振荡。面内取向的六方密排Co晶体c轴产生约0.36 T的各向异性场，使纳米收缩型器件能够在10 GHz以上发生自振荡。剩磁方向决定工作电流极性，并允许非易失性重构振荡状态；电流与各向异性轴之间的夹角则可调节激发阈值并控制谱支之间的同步行为。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 自旋霍尔纳米振荡器（SHNO）是用于无线通信、神经形态计算和基于振荡器的伊辛机的纳米尺度微波源，但传统器件需要全局磁偏置。本文利用外延Co/Pt中的晶体学各向异性取代这一偏置。生长c轴位于薄膜平面内的六方密排Co，可产生约0.36 T的各向异性场，并使纳米收缩型SHNO能够在无外加磁场条件下于10 GHz以上实现自振荡。工作电流的极性由剩磁方向选择，从而可以对振荡状态进行非易失性重构。微聚焦布里渊光散射测量证实，非线性响应局限于纳米收缩区域。通过光刻控制电流方向与各向异性轴之间的夹角，可以调节激发阈值，并使两个谱支从彼此分离的模式演化为由单一主导谱支构成的状态，这与相互同步相一致。这些结果表明，外延晶体学各向异性可以成为实现可重构无场自旋电子振荡器及振荡器网络的一条途径。

full_list.title_en: SIM-GRAPH: A universal guide to symmetric interactions
full_list.title_zh: SIM-GRAPH：对称相互作用的通用指南
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.09996v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Symmetry plays a central role throughout physics, from Fourier analysis on discrete lattices to the classification of elementary particles in the standard model. In finite quantum systems, symmetries are often discrete, such as reflection and rotational symmetries. Here, we present the SIM-GRAPH method (Symmetric Ising Models - Graph Reduction And Projected Hamiltonians), which uses such symmetries to efficiently calculate ground-state observables of interacting quantum systems. By projecting all interactions onto a symmetric subset of the system, the method effectively reduces the number of sites, thus providing an exponential speedup over standard exact diagonalization. Furthermore, we introduce two extensions that broaden the applicability of the method and allow for a controlled trade-off between computational cost and accuracy.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文提出SIM-GRAPH方法，即对称伊辛模型-图约化与投影哈密顿量方法，用于高效计算相互作用量子系统的基态可观测量。该方法将所有相互作用投影到系统的对称子集上，有效减少格点数目，相比标准精确对角化可实现指数级加速。作者还提出了两种扩展，以扩大方法适用范围，并在计算成本和精度之间实现可控权衡。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 对称性在物理学的各个领域都发挥着核心作用，从离散晶格上的傅里叶分析到标准模型中基本粒子的分类，均是如此。在有限量子系统中，对称性通常是离散的，例如反射对称性和旋转对称性。本文提出SIM-GRAPH方法，即对称伊辛模型-图约化与投影哈密顿量方法，利用这些对称性高效计算相互作用量子系统的基态可观测量。通过将所有相互作用投影到系统的一个对称子集上，该方法有效减少了格点数目，因此相较于标准精确对角化能够实现指数级加速。此外，本文还介绍了两种扩展，拓宽了该方法的适用性，并允许在计算成本与精度之间进行可控权衡。

full_list.title_en: Microscopic Understanding of Thermal-magnon Transport in a Low-damping Ferrimagnetic Thin Films
full_list.title_zh: 低阻尼亚铁磁薄膜中热磁振子输运的微观理解
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.09674v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Thermally generated magnons enable heat-driven spin transport in magnetic insulators, yet the microscopic mechanisms governing their propagation remain poorly understood. Here, we investigate thermal magnon transport in low-damping Li₀.₅Al₁.₀Fe₁.₅O₄/Pt nanodevices using a nonlocal spin Seebeck geometry that separates magnon transport from local thermoelectric effects. Thermal imaging establishes a detector region outside the thermal healing length, enabling intrinsic nonlocal measurements. We find that thermal magnon transport is strongly suppressed by magnetic fields far above saturation. Brillouin light scattering reveals that increasing field reduces the group velocity of backward volume magnons, providing a microscopic origin for the observed reduction in magnon spin diffusion length. We further find that thermal magnon transport decreases with increasing temperature despite an increasing magnon population. Micromagnetic simulations reproduce this behavior only when a temperature-dependent exchange stiffness is included. These results identify magnon group velocity and exchange stiffness as key parameters governing thermal magnon transport in ferrimagnetic thin films.
full_list.abstract_zh: 热激发磁振子能够在磁性绝缘体中实现热驱动自旋输运，但其传播机制尚未完全明确。该研究在Li₀.₅Al₁.₀Fe₁.₅O₄/Pt纳米器件中发现，高于磁饱和所需范围的磁场会显著抑制热磁振子输运，这与后向体磁振子群速度降低有关。结果还表明，温度升高时输运减弱，只有纳入温度依赖的交换刚度后，微磁模拟才能复现这一行为。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 热生成的磁振子能够在磁性绝缘体中实现热驱动自旋输运，但控制其传播的微观机制仍未得到充分理解。本文采用将磁振子输运与局域热电效应分离的非局域自旋塞贝克几何构型，研究了低阻尼Li₀.₅Al₁.₀Fe₁.₅O₄/Pt纳米器件中的热磁振子输运。热成像证实探测器区域位于热弛豫长度之外，从而能够进行内禀的非局域测量。我们发现，热磁振子输运会被远高于饱和场的磁场强烈抑制。布里渊光散射表明，增大磁场会降低后向体磁振子的群速度，从而为所观测到的磁振子自旋扩散长度减小提供了微观起源。我们进一步发现，尽管磁振子数目增加，热磁振子输运却随温度升高而减小。只有在纳入温度依赖的交换刚度时，微磁模拟才能复现这一行为。这些结果确定了磁振子群速度和交换刚度是控制亚铁磁薄膜中热磁振子输运的关键参数。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。

full_list.title_en: Coherent control of photon pairs via quantum interference between second- and third-order quantum nonlinear processes
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Coherent control of photon pairs via quantum interference between second- and third-order quantum nonlinear processes
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2601.18746v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Genuine quantum interference between independent nonlinear processes of different order provides a route to coherent control that cannot be reduced to a classical field interference. Here we present an all-optical analogue of coherent carrier injection by exploiting interference between second- and third-order quantum nonlinear processes in an integrated photonic platform. Photon pairs generated via spontaneous parametric down-conversion and spontaneous four-wave mixing coherently contribute to the same final two-photon state, resulting in a phase-dependent modulation of both the generation rate and the spectral structure of the emitted biphoton state. We illustrate the features of such interference and how it can be used to shape biphoton wavefunctions and their quantum correlations. These results identify interference between nonlinear processes of different order as a distinct form of coherent quantum control within quantum nonlinear optics.

full_list.title_en: Resolving the ground state intersection problem in coupled cluster theory
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Resolving the ground state intersection problem in coupled cluster theory
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.10164v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A physically correct description of ground state conical intersections is essential for simulating non-adiabatic dynamics of radiationless decay to the electronic ground state. Coupled cluster theory offers a particularly balanced treatment of static and dynamic correlation in excited states. However, coupled cluster methods and other single-reference approaches fail to describe ground state intersection regions, and several workarounds have been proposed to address this shortcoming. Here we present convex similarity constrained coupled cluster theory (CVX-SCC), a framework that resolves the ground state intersection problem by construction. We have applied this theory to two different coupled cluster methods, and tested the resulting models on ethylene, uracil, PSB3, and HeH₂, showing that both variants produce physically correct ground state conical intersections. With future development of nuclear gradients and non-adiabatic coupling vectors, this approach will provide single-reference electronic structures suitable for non-adiabatic dynamics simulations all the way to the ground state.

full_list.abstract: Author(s): Noah J. Fau, Rahul Meduri, Atreyee Das, Ryan E. Baumbach, Gregory T. McCandless, and Julia Y. Chan Co substitution in the kagome magnet TbFe 6 − x Co x Ge 6 drives a remarkable evolution of both crystal structure and magnetic behavior. Through combined diffraction and magnetization studies, the series transitions from an ordered orthorhombic phase to a hexagonal Yb 0 . 5 Co 3 Ge 3 -type structure as Co content increases. The gradual disappearance of superstructure reflections reveals suppression of short-range structural order, while magnetic measurements demonstrate significant modification of transition-metal sublattice magnetism. These results establish chemical substitution as an effective route for tuning the interplay between structural ordering and magnetic interactions in rare-earth kagome materials, providing new insight into composition-driven phase evolution. full_list.abstract: Author(s): Matthew C. O'Brien and Eduardo Fradkin Recent numerical advances have renewed interest in the two-dimensional quantum J 1 - J 3 Heisenberg antiferromagnet, but a detailed analytical theory has remained lacking. Here, the authors apply a semiclassical effective field theory and large- N analysis. They show that previously overlooked interactions stabilize a quantum vestigial nematic phase at zero temperature, where discrete rotational symmetry is spontaneously broken despite the loss of long-range antiferromagnetic spiral order. This phase continues the known finite-temperature nematic phase, reflecting enhanced quantum fluctuations near the classical Lifshitz point. [Phys. Rev. B 114, 134414] Published Thu Sep 10, 2026

full_list.title_en: Effective theory of quantum phases in the dipolar planar rotor chain
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Effective theory of quantum phases in the dipolar planar rotor chain
full_list.abstract: In this work, we develop a theoretical description of the collective behavior of interacting dipolar planar rotors by using time independent perturbation theory and a small angle quadratic approximation. The ground state properties of both the ordered and disordered quantum phases of the system are directly calculated and analyzed. Time-independent perturbation theory is shown to be appropriate for the disordered phase. For the ordered phase, we construct a quadratic approximation based on the stable equilibrium configurations of the dipolar ordering; we show that the inclusion of the quartic terms from the expansion of the potential energy is essential to correct the shift in the energy spectrum due to quantization ambiguities. Numerical techniques such as exact diagonalization and density matrix renormalization group are used to benchmark the quality of both approximations.

full_list.title_en: Comparative Electromagnetic Performance of Dual-Stator/Rotor Flux- Switching PM Machines with Different Magnetization Patterns Considering Magnetic Saturation for Bearingless Applications
full_list.title_zh: 考虑磁饱和的不同磁化模式双定子/转子磁通切换永磁电机电磁性能比较及其无轴承应用
full_list.abstract: This paper presents an accurate analytical subdomain model to examine the electromagnetic performance of a dual-stator/rotor flux-switching permanent magnet (FSPM) machine, which is suitable for high-speed turbo machinery (compressors, blowers, turbines), energy storage systems (flywheels), and similar applications. Three different magnetization patterns are considered, namely tangential, radial, and Halbach arrays. Magnetic saturation is taken into account through a compensation technique that relies on the actual B-H curves of the iron laminations. The field solution is obtained by analytically solving Maxwell's equations and the saturation factors for both stator and rotor teeth are derived separately to calculate the air-gap flux density under nonlinear operating conditions. Using the proposed model, the local traction forces are compared across the three magnetization patterns for bearingless applications, and the air-gap flux density is computed and compared across all configurations under both linear and saturated states. The radial and tangential flux components, as well as the radial pressure, are thoroughly investigated. The validity of the analytical model is confirmed through comparisons with finite element analysis (FEA), demonstrating very good agreement.
full_list.abstract_zh: 本文提出精确解析子域模型，用于研究适用于高速透平机械、飞轮等场景的双定子/转子磁通切换永磁电机。研究比较切向、径向和Halbach阵列三种磁化模式，并基于实际铁芯叠片B-H曲线补偿磁饱和效应。解析结果与有限元分析高度一致，且对无轴承应用中的局部牵引力、气隙磁密、磁场分量及径向压力进行了比较。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 本文提出了一种精确的解析子域模型，用于考察双定子/转子磁通切换永磁（FSPM）电机的电磁性能；该电机适用于高速透平机械，包括压缩机、鼓风机和涡轮机，亦适用于储能系统，包括飞轮，以及类似应用。研究考虑了三种不同的磁化模式，即切向、径向和Halbach阵列。通过一种依赖于铁芯叠片实际B-H曲线的补偿技术，考虑了磁饱和效应。通过解析求解麦克斯韦方程获得磁场解，并分别推导定子齿和转子齿的饱和系数，以计算非线性运行条件下的气隙磁通密度。利用所提出的模型，比较了三种磁化模式在无轴承应用中的局部牵引力，并计算和比较了所有构型在线性及饱和状态下的气隙磁通密度。对径向和切向磁通分量以及径向压力进行了深入研究。通过与有限元分析（FEA）进行比较，验证了该解析模型的有效性，结果显示二者符合得非常好。
full_list.summary: 本文提出精确解析子域模型，用于研究适用于高速透平机械、飞轮等场景的双定子/转子磁通切换永磁电机。研究比较切向、径向和Halbach阵列三种磁化模式，并基于实际铁芯叠片B-H曲线补偿磁饱和效应。解析结果与有限元分析高度一致，且对无轴承应用中的局部牵引力、气隙磁密、磁场分量及径向压力进行了比较。

full_list.title_en: An encoded asymmetric ligand for metal-selective topological assembly of two-dimensional metal-organic frameworks
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：An encoded asymmetric ligand for metal-selective topological assembly of two-dimensional metal-organic frameworks
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.09598v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Two-dimensional metal-organic frameworks (2D MOFs), with diverse topological architectures, provide a powerful platform for exploring unconventional electronic and lattice-dynamical responses. Yet their structural diversity remains fundamentally constrained by the fixed geometry of high-symmetry ligands. Here, we introduce an encoded asymmetric ligand, benzo[b]triphenylene-2,3,6,7,11,12-hexaol (BTH), for metal-selective topological assembly. By integrating multi-site coordination fields with sterically differentiated environments, BTH exhibits distinct topological programmability: different divalent metal ions direct divergent framework architectures. Specifically, coordination of BTH with divalent Cu(II) and Zn(II) ions assembles Cu-BTH-MOF with a dual-mode hexagonal pore topology and Zn-BTH-MOF with uniform hexagonal channels, respectively, as supported by PXRD Pawley refinement, structural simulations, and pore-size distribution analysis. Furthermore, this topological divergence is accompanied by a significant divergence in charge-transport properties, with Cu-BTH-MOF reaching an electrical conductivity of 1.186 x 10-3 S cm-1, more than six orders of magnitude higher than that of Zn-BTH-MOF (3.38 x 10-10 S cm-1). This work establishes ligand desymmetrization as a programmable strategy for metal-selective topological diversification in 2D MOFs.

full_list.title_en: Controlled Parity of Cooper Pair Tunneling in a Hybrid Superconducting Qubit
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Controlled Parity of Cooper Pair Tunneling in a Hybrid Superconducting Qubit
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2601.11303v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Superconducting quantum circuits derive their nonlinearity from the Josephson energy-phase relation. Besides the fundamental cosφ term, this relation can also contain higher Fourier harmonics cos(kφ) corresponding to correlated tunneling of k Cooper pairs. The parity of the dominant tunneling process, i.e.~whether an odd or even number of Cooper pairs tunnel, results in qualitatively different properties, and controlling this opens up a wide range of applications in superconducting technology. However, access to even-dominated regimes has remained challenging and has so far relied on complex multi-junction or all-hybrid architectures. Here, we demonstrate a simple "harmonic parity qubit" (HPQ); an element that combines two aluminum-oxide tunnel junctions in parallel to a gate-tunable InAs/Al nanowire junction forming a SQUID, and use spectroscopy versus flux to reconstruct its energy-phase relation at 85 gate voltage points. At half flux quantum, the odd harmonics of the Josephson potential can be suppressed by up to two orders of magnitude relative to the even harmonics, producing a double-well potential dominated by even harmonics with minima near ±π/2. The ability to control harmonic parity enables supercurrent carried by pairs of Cooper pairs and provides a new building block for Fourier engineering in superconducting circuits.

full_list.title_en: Dimensional Control of Excitonic Interactions in Exfoliated 2D Molecular Crystals
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Dimensional Control of Excitonic Interactions in Exfoliated 2D Molecular Crystals
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.09923v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Two-dimensional (2D) materials provide unique opportunities to tailor excited-state properties through reduced dimensionality, altered dielectric screening and layer-dependent structural reconstruction. While such effects have been widely explored in norganic systems, their realization in molecular crystals has been limited by the difficulty of controlling thickness at the atomic scale while preserving crystalline order. Here we show that tetracene and three other molecular crystals can be mechanically exfoliated into mono-, few- or multilayer flakes, while retaining crystalline order. This capability enables new studies of molecular crystals across a well defined thickness range within the same structural organization. Thickness-dependent spectra of these samples reveal how out-of-plane confinement modifies the excited-state energy landscape of tetracene: With decreasing thickness, the Davydov splitting diminishes, the Stokes shift increases, and signatures of more delocalized excitons emerge. Electron diffraction and exciton model-based analyses correlate these trends to changes in molecular packing, intermolecular coupling and dielectric screening. Our results also demonstrate that key features of molecular excitons can be systematically tuned by layer number, extending dimensional control from inorganic 2D materials to molecular crystals.

full_list.title_en: Effect of electron-hole asymmetry on Δ_T noise in metal/quantum point contact/metal and metal/quantum point contact/superconductor junctions

full_list.abstract: arXiv:2601.00402v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: This work examines charge Δ_T noise in two-terminal hybrid nanostructures featuring a quantum point contact (QPC), realized either between two normal metallic leads (NQN) or between a normal metal and a superconducting lead (NQS). The energy-dependent transmission of a QPC breaks electron-hole (e-h) symmetry, leading to a finite thermovoltage under an applied temperature and voltage bias. In contrast, in earlier studies on hybrid junctions incorporating insulating barriers, as electron-hole symmetry is preserved, have vanishing thermovoltage, and consequently, charge Δ_T noise is calculated at zero thermovoltage. In our setup, the broken e-h symmetry allows for a finite thermovoltage, at which we compute the corresponding charge Δ_T noise. Unlike earlier studies restricted by electron-hole symmetry and vanishing thermovoltage, our work establishes a self-consistent thermoelectric noise framework in mesoscopic hybrid junctions, revealing how Andreev reflection fundamentally reshapes charge Δ_T noise once electron-hole symmetry is broken. This broad access to charge fluctuation signatures provides a more comprehensive understanding of non-equilibrium transport in linear response. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work that systematically explores the interplay between Andreev reflection and electron-hole symmetry breaking in the context of quantum noise and Δ_T noise in mesoscopic hybrid structures.

full_list.title_en: Emergent Electronic Bond-Order Wave in a Quasi-One-Dimensional Chain
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Emergent Electronic Bond-Order Wave in a Quasi-One-Dimensional Chain
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.09383v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Collective order is notoriously difficult to stabilize in one dimension, where strong fluctuations suppress symmetry-breaking states. Here we report the emergence of an electronic bond-order wave (BOW) in the quasi-one-dimensional (1D) material Ba9Rh8O24, in which structural bonds become active electronic degrees of freedom that overcome 1D fluctuations to establish long-range order. Single-crystal X-ray diffraction uncovers a striking inversion of inequivalent Rh-Rh bonds across a transition TA = 180 K, where short and long bonds interchange their identities rather than undergoing conventional Peierls dimerization. This bond inversion coincides with a heat-capacity anomaly and a profound reorganization of the dielectric response with strong suppression of dielectric loss upon cooling. The BOW exhibits strongly nonlinear, frequency-dependent I-V characteristics, clockwise hysteresis, and nonvolatile memristive switching. These findings uncover an unprecedented transformation from a dynamic bond liquid to a rigid yet electrically reconfigurable BOW, establishing bond-centered electronic order as a new organizing principle for 1D quantum matter.

full_list.title_en: Instance-Aware Algorithm Selection for Maximum Clique via a Dual-Channel Graph Neural Architecture
full_list.title_zh: 基于双通道图神经架构的最大团实例感知算法选择
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2508.08005v5 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Although the Maximum Clique Problem (MCP) has been extensively studied and features a rich ecosystem of exact solvers, empirical evidence shows that solver performance varies substantially across graph families. Consequently, selecting an appropriate algorithm for a given instance remains an open and practically important challenge that has received little systematic attention. We address this gap by developing an instance-aware selection framework that systematically combines global statistical descriptors with learned topological representations. We construct a comprehensive benchmark by evaluating four state-of-the-art exact solvers on a diverse collection of graph instances and deriving both global statistical and local structural features. An evaluation of conventional classifiers establishes Random Forest as a strong baseline and reveals that connectivity and topological features are key predictors of performance. Motivated by these observations, we introduce a dual-channel architecture that jointly leverages a Graph Attention Network for capturing local neighborhood patterns and a Multilayer Perceptron for modeling global statistical features. Extensive experiments show that the proposed dual-channel model consistently surpasses classical baselines and the single-best solver, achieving 90.43% test accuracy. These findings demonstrate the value of integrating local topological encoding with global statistical cues for combinatorial algorithm selection. Code and models are available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/GAT-MLP-7E5F.
full_list.abstract_zh: 针对最大团问题中不同图族导致求解器性能差异显著的问题，本文提出一种实例感知的算法选择框架。该框架结合全局统计描述符与局部拓扑表示，使用图注意力网络建模邻域模式，并用多层感知机建模全局特征。大量实验表明，双通道模型优于经典分类器、单一最佳求解器和单通道模型，在测试集上达到90.43%的准确率。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 尽管最大团问题（MCP）已经被广泛研究，并形成了丰富的精确求解器体系，但实验证据表明，求解器性能会在不同图族之间产生显著差异。因此，如何为给定实例选择合适的算法仍然是一个开放且具有实际重要性的挑战，而这一问题尚未得到系统研究。我们通过开发一种实例感知的选择框架来弥补这一缺口，该框架系统地结合全局统计描述符与学习得到的拓扑表示。我们在多样化的图实例集合上评估了四种最先进的精确求解器，构建了一个综合基准，并提取了全局统计特征与局部结构特征。对传统分类器的评估表明，随机森林是一个强基线，同时揭示出连通性和拓扑特征是性能的重要预测因素。基于这些观察，我们提出一种双通道架构，将图注意力网络用于捕捉局部邻域模式，将多层感知机用于建模全局统计特征。大量实验表明，所提出的双通道模型持续优于经典基线和单一最佳求解器，在测试集上取得90.43%的准确率。这些结果说明，将局部拓扑编码与全局统计线索相结合，对于组合优化算法选择具有重要价值。代码和模型已经公开。

full_list.title_en: BTBR: A Bayesian-Theory-Driven Probabilistic-Fuzzy Framework for Implicit Bias Removal in Large Language Models
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：BTBR: A Bayesian-Theory-Driven Probabilistic-Fuzzy Framework for Implicit Bias Removal in Large Language Models
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2408.10608v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) may encode biased associations from heterogeneous training corpora that are not immediately visible under ordinary prompting, but can surface when the model is steered toward particular demographic personas. Such behavior often manifests not as explicit toxic output, but as systematic performance differences across semantically equivalent tasks, making the resulting bias difficult to detect and mitigate. To address this issue, we formalize the implicit bias problem as persona-induced performance disparity and argue that bias evidence should be treated as a graded signal rather than a binary label. Motivated by this observation, we model biased knowledge as a fuzzy subset equipped with an explicit membership function that reflects the strength of bias evidence for each candidate example. Building on this formulation, we propose Bayesian-Theory-based Bias Removal (BTBR), a hybrid probabilistic-fuzzy framework for identifying and removing latent bias traces from model parameters. BTBR first performs likelihood-ratio screening to measure how strongly candidate samples align with a target biased persona, then converts high-membership samples into structured knowledge triples, and finally applies targeted model editing with a lightweight fuzzy rule scheduler to reduce collateral performance degradation under high entanglement risk. Extensive experiments across multiple bias sources, tasks, model families and editing backends show that BTBR consistently reduces persona-induced performance gaps while preserving general reasoning ability. These results demonstrate that combining probabilistic evidence with fuzzy degree modeling provides an effective and practical approach for mitigating implicit bias in large language models.

It models UAV motion and attitude, time-varying Rician angles, and angle-dependent RIS reflection. full_list.title_en: Beyond Prompts: Measuring and Optimizing LLM Tool-Agent Harnesses
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Beyond Prompts: Measuring and Optimizing LLM Tool-Agent Harnesses
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.05736v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: LLM tool agents can be improved without retraining by modifying the runtime harness around a fixed model: prompts, tool interfaces, middleware, state handling, and recovery logic. We study this setting as resource-bounded harness selection for fixed-model multi-turn tool agents, with the search surface scoped to prompts and tool-boundary middleware: edits are guarded intercepts at the tool boundary, not arbitrary rewriting of agent execution logic. Our optimizer-agnostic protocol reports mean held-out lift, worst-condition lift, repeatability, logged cost diagnostics, and RelLift95(B), a conservative estimate of the held-out gain of the harness selected under budget B. We instantiate the protocol with prompt-only and prompt-plus-middleware optimizers, including PRISM, which clusters failures and routes repairs to prompt, tool-boundary middleware, or joint edit surfaces within a Pareto search. On BFCL multi-round, tau2-Retail, and tau2-Telecom, PRISM obtains mean held-out lifts of 14.2, 14.9, and 10.1 percentage points and positive empirical RelLift95 on all three benchmarks, and a component ablation attributes the margin chiefly to failure-surface routing and the edit-pattern constraint. Across optimizers, the results show that some search procedures can occasionally find large gains but still choose brittle updates, so the reliability of the chosen harness should be reported alongside average held-out lift.

core_items.title_en: Fast, Accurate, and Scalable Fermionic Neural Networks via Translation Equivariance
core_items.title_zh: 通过平移等变性实现快速、精确且可扩展的费米子神经网络
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2609.10186v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We demonstrate that designing a neural quantum state to be an exact eigenstate of the Hamiltonian's symmetries significantly improves both training speed and final variational energy. For the 2D electron gas, we design TorFormer, a neural network wavefunction which is an exact eigenstate of the total momentum. TorFormer describes both the Fermi liquid and Wigner crystal with no supervision and significantly outperforms Psiformer-based references up to large system sizes. For rₛ = 30.0 and 40.0 at N=91, we compare TorFormer trained for 8K steps against the previous best NQS, which required 100K training steps. Our improvement to the total energy at rₛ = 40.0, excluding the trivial Madelung part, is 0.12%---enormous compared to the tiny differences separating phases. Relative to Slater-Jastrow-backflow diffusion Monte Carlo, TorFormer's energy decrease is roughly 9.8 times that of the previous best NQS. Our work demonstrates that neural quantum states can both accurately and efficiently solve large-scale problems.
core_items.abstract_zh: 本文表明，使神经量子态成为哈密顿量对称性的精确本征态，能够显著提高训练速度并降低最终变分能量。针对二维电子气，作者构建了具有总动量精确本征性的TorFormer，在无监督条件下同时描述费米液体和维格纳晶体，并在较大体系中显著优于基于Psiformer的参考方法。结果显示，该方法能够高效求解大规模量子多体问题，并在区分竞争相所需的微小能量差方面取得明显改进。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 我们证明，使神经量子态成为哈密顿量对称性的精确本征态，能够显著提升训练速度并降低最终的变分能量。针对二维电子气，我们设计了TorFormer，这是一种具有总动量精确本征性的神经网络波函数。TorFormer无需监督即可同时描述费米液体和维格纳晶体，并且在较大体系尺寸下显著优于基于Psiformer的参考方法。对于rs=30.0和40.0、粒子数N=91的体系，我们将经过8K步训练的TorFormer与此前最优的神经量子态进行比较，后者需要进行100K步训练。在rs=40.0时，除去平凡的马德隆项后，我们对总能量的改进达到0.12%；与区分不同相所需的微小能量差相比，这一改进十分显著。相对于Slater-Jastrow-回馈扩散蒙特卡洛方法，TorFormer带来的能量降低约为此前最佳神经量子态的9.8倍。我们的工作表明，神经量子态能够高精度且高效率地求解大规模问题。
core_items.summary: 本文表明，使神经量子态成为哈密顿量对称性的精确本征态，能够显著提高训练速度并降低最终变分能量。针对二维电子气，作者构建了具有总动量精确本征性的TorFormer，在无监督条件下同时描述费米液体和维格纳晶体，并在较大体系中显著优于基于Psiformer的参考方法。结果显示，该方法能够高效求解大规模量子多体问题，并在区分竞争相所需的微小能量差方面取得明显改进。
core_items.focus_summary: 该工作提出具有平移等变性的 TorFormer 神经量子态，用于高效求解二维电子气的基态波函数。结果表明，显式满足总动量对称性能够提升训练速度和变分能精度，并改善对费米液体与 Wigner 晶体的描述。
core_items.focus_relation: 与我们的机器学习和量子多体模拟存在方法上的间接联系，但研究对象主要是二维均匀电子气，而非具体材料的电子结构、原子势能或材料性质预测。其对称性约束神经网络的思想可有限借鉴到等变电子哈密顿量和多体波函数建模中。
core_items.focus_suggestion: 可关注其平移对称性与等变神经网络的设计，并评估能否扩展到周期性晶体、磁性体系或具有自旋轨道耦合的材料。若研究重点是材料模拟，则应优先考察其与机器学习 Kohn-Sham 哈密顿量或电子密度预测的结合。
core_items.method_point: TorFormer面向周期边界二维电子气的连续坐标波函数学习，将电子坐标输入经平移等变的注意力表示，使多体神经波函数在晶格平移下严格获得指定总动量相位。模型在变分蒙特卡洛框架中以哈密顿量局域能为无监督目标优化，并用费米子反对称结构表征交换统计；作者将其与Psiformer基线比较，考察费米液体和维格纳晶体及其极小能量差。关键设计不是事后数据增强，而是在网络层面强制波函数属于平移对称群的本征表示，从而降低优化中无关自由度。
core_items.related_work: 该路线对应把守恒量、空间群或E(3)对称性嵌入模型的物理归纳偏置，与Hongyu Yu和Hongjun Xiang发展等变GNN、机器学习Kohn-Sham哈密顿量的思路一致，但对象由原子局域环境转为显式电子坐标及费米子节点。它也与量子蒙特卡洛中的Slater-Jastrow、backflow和Transformer神经量子态互补，优势在于总动量精确而非仅靠训练采样学习。对团队的铁电和磁性问题，BaTiO3软模、CrI3磁激发并非同一连续电子气模型，却同样受平移对称、有限尺寸和竞争能标解析度限制。
core_items.implication: 可先以二维电子气和小尺寸Hubbard模型复现总动量扇区能量，再将平移等变模块嵌入团队的Wannier紧束缚模型，用于FeTeSe、CrSBr或扭转范德华磁体的关联电子基态比较。数据应由DFT-Wannier给出跃迁、SOC和库仑参数，并在不同超胞、载流子密度和边界扭转相位下采样；训练采用变分能量加粒子数和动量投影约束。验证需同精确对角化或DMRG的小体系能量、结构因子和动量分布对照，并检查不同胞长下磁序或电荷序能差是否收敛。

core_items.title_en: High-quality, high-information datasets for universal atomistic machine learning
core_items.title_zh: 文献研究：High-quality, high-information datasets for universal atomistic machine learning
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2603.02089v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The quality, consistency, and information content of training data is often what determines the practical value of machine-learning models for atomistic simulations. Yet, many widely used electronic-structure databases are assembled having materials screening as primary goal rather than robust force-field learning, are limited in their scope to a specific class of chemical compounds, and/or employ inconsistent DFT functionals and settings. Here we introduce MAD-1.6, a highly curated dataset designed explicitly for training broadly applicable atomistic models across the periodic table at high levels of theory. MAD-1.6 extends the MAD dataset with targeted enrichment strategies that improve the coverage of chemical space to 102 elements while keeping the total number of configurations compact. All structures are computed with a single, standardized all-electron DFT workflow using the r²SCAN meta-GGA functional and consistent convergence settings, ensuring uniformity across chemically heterogeneous systems. The dataset encompasses molecules, clusters, bulk crystals, surfaces, and low-dimensional structures, and its quality and consistency are further enhanced by outlier removal using uncertainty quantification. We demonstrate the high accuracy that can be achieved with the proposed dataset by training PET-MAD-1.6, a generally applicable r²SCAN interatomic potential that covers 102 elements in the periodic table and achieves exceptional levels of benchmark accuracy and stability in challenging simulation protocols.
core_items.summary: 该工作发布了 MAD-1.6 高质量原子级机器学习数据集，采用统一的全电子 DFT 流程和 r²SCAN 泛函，覆盖 102 种元素以及分子、团簇、块体、表面和低维结构。数据集通过针对性扩充化学空间和提高数据一致性，旨在支持具有广泛适用性的机器学习原子模型和势函数训练。
core_items.focus_summary: 该工作发布了 MAD-1.6 高质量原子级机器学习数据集，采用统一的全电子 DFT 流程和 r²SCAN 泛函，覆盖 102 种元素以及分子、团簇、块体、表面和低维结构。数据集通过针对性扩充化学空间和提高数据一致性，旨在支持具有广泛适用性的机器学习原子模型和势函数训练。
core_items.focus_relation: 与我们的机器学习势、等变图神经网络、分子动力学、材料信息学和高通量计算方向直接相关。统一计算设置与多类型结构覆盖有助于训练跨化学体系的势能、力和张量性质模型，并可作为主动学习数据集的基准。
core_items.focus_suggestion: 建议比较 MAD-1.6 对不同等变神经网络、长程库仑模型和自旋相关机器学习势的影响，重点测试铁电、磁性、缺陷和界面体系。还可评估其在非绝热动力学、离子迁移、热输运和极化翻转等任务中的数据覆盖不足。
core_items.method_point: 该文聚焦通用原子机器学习所需训练集的质量、一致性和信息量，指出面向材料筛选构建的电子结构数据库通常不足以直接训练稳定的力场。其方法学核心是以原子构型覆盖、能量和力标签一致性、化学空间多样性及高应力或缺陷态信息密度评价数据，而非只累计平衡晶体条目。摘要未给出完整数据源、标注泛函和模型基准参数，因此实际使用时不能把它等同于已可下载的统一势函数数据集；重点应视为数据策展和评测准则。
core_items.related_work: 这与MACE、NequIP、Allegro、NEP等等变或局域机器学习势对力标签、非平衡构型和元素覆盖的依赖直接呼应，也解释了MP、OQMD等以静态形成能筛选为主的数据难以支撑长时间MD。Hongyu Yu的可迁移MLIP和带电缺陷电子结构、Xin-Gao Gong的主动学习与缺陷动力学、Weibin Chu的非绝热动力学均受此约束。对于HfO2相变、钙钛矿离子迁移、CrI3自旋-晶格耦合，单纯0 K理想胞数据不能覆盖畴壁、缺陷、电荷态和高温涨落。
core_items.implication: 团队可建立按任务分层的数据协议：以DFT+U或杂化泛函统一标注HfO2、BaTiO3、CrI3和卤化物钙钛矿的能量、力、应力、磁矩及必要张量，平衡相仅作种子集。随后从升温降温MD、应变扫描、NEB鞍点、畴壁、表面、空位和带电缺陷主动选择高不确定构型，并保留电子温度、U值、SOC和自旋初态元数据。验证应独立测试声子、弹性、缺陷迁移垒、相变温度和长程MD稳定性，同时以委员会方差和外推构型比例审计可迁移范围。

core_items.title_en: Octahedral-field-informed machine learning for accelerated discovery of two-dimensional magnets with perpendicular magnetic anisotropy
core_items.title_zh: 文献研究：Octahedral-field-informed machine learning for accelerated discovery of two-dimensional magnets with perpendicular magnetic anisotropy
core_items.abstract: Author(s): Yanyan Yang, Xinyu Chen, Qian Xia, Qionghua Zhou, Qian Chen, and Jinlan Wang Magnetic anisotropy is a fundamental prerequisite for stabilizing long-range order in two-dimensional (2D) magnets, yet its evaluation via first-principles methods is computationally prohibitive for large-scale material discovery. Here, an octahedral-field-informed machine learning framework is repo… [Phys. Rev. Applied 26, 034023] Published Thu Sep 10, 2026
core_items.summary: 该工作针对二维磁体中垂直磁各向异性难以通过大规模第一性原理计算高效评估的问题，构建了融入八面体晶场物理信息的机器学习框架。其目标是快速筛选具有稳定长程磁序潜力的二维磁性材料，并以物理先验提升预测与材料发现效率。
core_items.focus_summary: 该工作针对二维磁体中垂直磁各向异性难以通过大规模第一性原理计算高效评估的问题，构建了融入八面体晶场物理信息的机器学习框架。其目标是快速筛选具有稳定长程磁序潜力的二维磁性材料，并以物理先验提升预测与材料发现效率。
core_items.focus_relation: 与团队的二维范德华磁体、磁各向异性、自旋轨道耦合、机器学习势和图神经网络材料筛选方向高度直接相关。八面体晶场特征与物理约束机器学习的思路可用于团队的自旋哈密顿量、磁交换参数及磁性拓扑性质预测。
core_items.focus_suggestion: 建议重点阅读其特征构造、训练数据来源、泛化验证及候选材料的第一性原理复核流程。可进一步将晶场描述符与等变图神经网络结合，联合预测磁各向异性、交换作用和居里温度，并开展主动学习高通量筛选。
core_items.method_point: 该工作针对二维磁体中决定有限温磁序稳定性的垂直磁各向异性，以八面体晶场信息构造机器学习框架，替代对每个候选物逐一实施昂贵SOC第一性原理磁各向异性能计算。输入应围绕金属离子的配位八面体、配体种类和畸变所决定的d轨道分裂及占据特征，模型学习这些局域晶场量与易轴各向异性的关联，再服务大规模候选筛选。摘要未披露具体回归器、训练集规模和DFT泛函，不能据此假定其已准确处理非共线磁序或长程交换；其物理价值在于显式编码晶场先验。
core_items.related_work: 该思路与用结构描述符预测磁各向异性、Curie温度和交换常数的高通量工作相连，但比黑箱成分回归更贴近SOC、轨道矩和八面体畸变的微观来源。它可同Hongjun Xiang的群论、自旋哈密顿量和磁电耦合研究，以及Hongyu Yu的等变网络自旋-晶格模型结合。CrI3和CrSBr均可作为团队熟悉的对照体系：前者具有强各向异性与卤素SOC，后者低对称晶格导致显著面内各向异性，因而不应把八面体描述符机械外推为普适的垂直易轴判据。
core_items.implication: 可先用CrI3、CrBr3、CrCl3及含畸变配位的CrSBr构建基准集，在固定磁序下以含SOC的DFT+U计算不同自旋方向总能，并提取局域键长、键角、配体原子序数、晶场分裂和轨道磁矩。训练晶场描述符模型与MACE等变GNN并行预测单离子各向异性和MAE，再将候选物的J、D和各向异性代入自旋哈密顿量蒙特卡洛。验证包括留族元素外推、应变下易轴翻转、与显式SOC复算的误差，以及由磁各向异性推得的有限温磁化曲线。

core_items.title_en: uFlowCSP: Crystal Structure Prediction using Mean flow generative models
core_items.title_zh: uFlowCSP：利用平均流生成模型进行晶体结构预测
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2609.09799v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Crystal structure prediction (CSP) is fundamental to computational materials discovery. Generative models including CDVAE, DiffCSP, FlowMM, and CrystalFlow learn stable-crystal distributions directly, but diffusion and flow-matching inference requires tens to thousands of sequential network evaluations per candidate. We introduce uFlowCSP, a MeanFlow-based CSP model that learns the average, rather than instantaneous, probability-flow velocity. It generates a complete structure in one to five evaluations, delivering 5x-58x faster inference with equal or better performance. A chemistry- and symmetry-aware Transformer uses canonical atom ordering, global composition, and per-token chemistry embeddings. A coarse crystal-system token is used only during training; it provides additive gains, particularly improving space-group agreement despite being absent at inference, which remains formula-only. On MP-20 with 20 candidates per target, one step matches CrystalFlow (78.38% vs. 78.34%) with 100x fewer evaluations and about 10x lower wall-clock time. Five steps reach 83.64%, exceeding CrystalFlow (78.34% at 2,000 evaluations) and DiffCSP (77.93% at about 20,000), while using 20x fewer evaluations. uFlowCSP generates 10,000 structures in 0.39-1.31 minutes, versus 6.5 for CrystalFlow and 76.1 for DiffCSP. Under CSPBench's energy-ranked top-five structure-and-space-group criterion, five-step uFlowCSP reaches 72%/72%/65% structure, space-group, and consensus match rates. CrystalFlow reaches 78%/73%/68% at 100 steps but falls to 49%/32%/31% at five. Thus, uFlowCSP improves accuracy per network evaluation, not merely peak accuracy.
core_items.abstract_zh: 本文提出uFlowCSP，一种基于MeanFlow的晶体结构预测模型，通过学习平均概率流速度而非瞬时速度，将每个候选结构的生成评估次数降低至1至5次。该模型结合化学和对称性感知的Transformer，在保持或提升精度的同时实现了显著加速；在MP-20数据集上，单步推理即可匹配CrystalFlow的性能，五步推理则取得更高的结构预测准确率。结果表明，uFlowCSP提升了每次网络评估所获得的精度，而不仅仅是追求最高精度。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 晶体结构预测（CSP）是计算材料发现的基础。包括CDVAE、DiffCSP、FlowMM和CrystalFlow在内的生成模型能够直接学习稳定晶体的分布，但扩散模型和流匹配模型在推理时需要对每个候选结构进行数十次到数千次连续网络评估。本文提出uFlowCSP，一种基于MeanFlow的CSP模型，它学习平均概率流速度，而不是瞬时概率流速度。该模型只需进行1至5次评估即可生成完整结构，实现了5倍至58倍的推理加速，同时保持相当或更好的性能。模型采用具有化学和对称性感知能力的Transformer，并结合规范化原子排序、全局组成信息以及逐标记化学嵌入。在训练阶段，模型还使用粗粒度晶体系统标记；尽管该标记在推理时被移除、推理仍仅依赖化学式，但它能够带来额外收益，尤其可以改善空间群的一致性。在MP-20数据集上，对于每个目标生成20个候选结构时，单步推理的结构匹配率为78.38%，与CrystalFlow的78.34%相当，但网络评估次数减少了100倍，实际耗时约降低10倍。五步推理的匹配率达到83.64%，高于CrystalFlow在2,000次评估下的78.34%和DiffCSP在约20,000次评估下的77.93%，同时评估次数减少了20倍。uFlowCSP生成10,000个结构仅需0.39至1.31分钟，而CrystalFlow和DiffCSP分别需要6.5分钟和76.1分钟。在CSPBench的按能量排序的前五个结构与空间群评价标准下，五步uFlowCSP的结构、空间群和共识匹配率分别达到72%、72%和65%。CrystalFlow在100步推理下的相应结果为78%、73%和68%，但在五步推理时下降至49%、32%和31%。因此，uFlowCSP提升的是每次网络评估所对应的精度，而不仅仅是最高精度。
core_items.summary: 本文提出uFlowCSP，一种基于MeanFlow的晶体结构预测模型，通过学习平均概率流速度而非瞬时速度，将每个候选结构的生成评估次数降低至1至5次。该模型结合化学和对称性感知的Transformer，在保持或提升精度的同时实现了显著加速；在MP-20数据集上，单步推理即可匹配CrystalFlow的性能，五步推理则取得更高的结构预测准确率。结果表明，uFlowCSP提升了每次网络评估所获得的精度，而不仅仅是追求最高精度。
core_items.focus_summary: 该工作提出 uFlowCSP，利用 MeanFlow 生成模型进行晶体结构预测，通过学习平均概率流速度，将结构生成所需的网络评估次数降低到 1 至 5 次。模型结合化学组成、原子排序和晶体对称性信息，在 MP-20 数据集上以更低推理成本取得了与现有扩散或流匹配方法相当甚至更好的性能。
core_items.focus_relation: 与我们的晶体结构预测、高通量筛选、机器学习和逆向材料设计方向高度相关。其快速生成策略可用于扩大铁电、磁性、二维材料和固态电解质候选空间，并与第一性原理计算形成主动学习闭环。
core_items.focus_suggestion: 建议评估该方法在磁性、极性结构、含缺陷晶体和二维范德华异质结构中的泛化能力，尤其关注磁序和空间群约束是否能够被可靠保留。可进一步将生成模型与 DFT 稳定性计算、性质预测模型和主动学习结合。
core_items.method_point: uFlowCSP采用MeanFlow生成式建模进行晶体结构预测，学习平均概率流速度而非传统流模型沿时间的瞬时速度，从而以每个候选结构约1至5次网络评估完成生成。网络使用同时感知化学组成和对称性的Transformer，在给定组分条件下输出晶格与原子位置的去噪或流动更新；MP-20基准中单步性能可比CrystalFlow，五步更新进一步提高结构匹配率。方法的关键是将少步采样目标纳入训练，使网络每次评估承担更长时间跨度的生成校正，而不是依赖许多小步数值积分。
core_items.related_work: 它与扩散式CSP、正常化流、CrystalFlow以及基于图网络的结构生成工作同属逆向晶体设计，但优化重点从最终大量采样步数转为平均流的少步高保真推断。与Hongyu Yu、Xin-Gao Gong的主动学习MLIP工作可形成前后衔接：生成模型提出新结构，等变势快速弛豫并筛除不稳定候选。对于铁电HfO2、BaTiO3衍生物和二维滑移铁电，空间群条件很重要，但生成的高对称初始结构仍可能遗漏极性畸变、层间滑移及多畴自由度，必须结合软模和能垒搜索。
core_items.implication: 可将uFlowCSP用于含Hf-Zr-O、层状卤素硫族物或Cr-X体系的成分约束生成，训练前以Materials Project结构加团队DFT弛豫的极性和磁性结构扩充语料，并显式保留空间群、层数和化学计量条件。生成后先以MACE或NEP在零压及目标应变下弛豫，再以DFT+U+SOC复算形成能、声子和磁交换；铁电候选需沿极性模式计算Berry相极化与NEB翻转势垒。评价不能只报结构匹配率，还应统计生成后动力学稳定率、极性相相对能和目标磁各向异性命中率。

core_items.title_en: SSCHA-based evolutionary crystal structure prediction at finite temperatures with account for quantum nuclear motion
core_items.title_zh: 文献研究：SSCHA-based evolutionary crystal structure prediction at finite temperatures with account for quantum nuclear motion
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2512.24849v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Reliable crystal structure prediction (CSP) at finite temperatures, including quantum anharmonic effects, remains challenging but is particularly important for systems containing light atoms such as superconducting hydrides. Here, we integrate machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) with the stochastic self-consistent harmonic approximation (SSCHA) to enable evolutionary CSP on the quantum anharmonic free-energy landscape. Using LaH10 as a test case, we compare three approaches: (i) active-learning MLIPs (AL-MLIPs) trained on the fly, (ii) universal MLIPs (uMLIPs), and (iii) temperature-dependent effective potentials (TDEPs) trained on SSCHA ensemble data. AL-MLIPs correctly predict the cubic Fm-3m phase but require thermodynamic perturbation theory corrections for consistent results. The foundation uMLIP Mattersim-5m enables SSCHA-based CSP without per-structure training, but fine-tuning is required for higher accuracy. Temperature-dependent effective potentials trained on SSCHA data enable accurate and very efficient CSP for large unit cells on the quantum anharmonic free-energy landscape. We demonstrate that quantum anharmonicity simplifies the free-energy landscape and is essential for the correct energy ranking of LaH10 structures.
core_items.summary: 该工作将机器学习原子间势与随机自洽谐近似结合，用于考虑量子核效应和非谐自由能的有限温度进化晶体结构预测。以LaH10为例，结果表明在线主动学习势、通用势微调及基于SSCHA数据训练的温度相关有效势均可支持结构搜索，其中后者在大晶胞计算中兼具较高精度和效率。
core_items.focus_summary: 该工作将机器学习原子间势与随机自洽谐近似结合，用于考虑量子核效应和非谐自由能的有限温度进化晶体结构预测。以LaH10为例，结果表明在线主动学习势、通用势微调及基于SSCHA数据训练的温度相关有效势均可支持结构搜索，其中后者在大晶胞计算中兼具较高精度和效率。
core_items.focus_relation: 与团队的机器学习势、主动学习、晶体结构预测、分子动力学及超导材料研究方向直接相关。其以自由能面而非零温势能面驱动结构搜索的思路，可借鉴到轻元素体系、量子铁电体和有限温度相变材料。
core_items.focus_suggestion: 可重点阅读其SSCHA数据构造、热力学微扰校正和势函数验证流程，并评估其对HfO2基铁电体或氢化物相稳定性的适用性。可进一步发展同时描述极化、应变和非谐振动的温度依赖机器学习势。
core_items.method_point: 该工作把机器学习原子间势嵌入随机自洽谐近似SSCHA与进化式晶体结构预测，在有限温自由能面上同时考虑强非谐振动和量子核涨落。MLIP承担大量能量与力评估，SSCHA以随机采样的高斯试探密度矩阵优化有效力常数和结构，进化搜索则在候选构型间迭代选择、交叉和变异。该组合避免只依据0 K静态焓排序，尤其适合含轻原子的超导氢化物；摘要未给出势模型类型、压力温度网格及SSCHA收敛阈值，复现时需单独设定。
core_items.related_work: 这比常规AIRSS或USPEX加静态DFT弛豫更接近实验热力学条件，也比经典MLIP-MD更能处理质子零点能和量子非谐性。它与Xin-Gao Gong的MLIP、相变和电子-声子耦合研究密切相关，并可延展Weibin Chu采用路径积分MD描述轻离子或极化子核效应的路线。HfO2和BaTiO3的铁电软模虽以重原子为主，仍存在显著非谐自由能；卤化物钙钛矿的转动、氢键和离子迁移则更需要有限温结构而非单点晶格优化。
core_items.implication: 可在BaTiO3、HfO2和含氢卤化物钙钛矿上建立分阶段验证：用PBEsol或SCAN标注多相、软模位移、应变和高温MD快照，再主动学习训练MACE或NEP势。对每个候选相在实验相关温压下运行SSCHA，输出自由能、重整化声子和平均结构；对含氢体系增加路径积分MD交叉检查零点能。以DFT自由能抽样点、实验相变温度、介电软模频率和极化分布验证，并将低自由能极性相进一步用Berry相极化和NEB确定可翻转性。

core_items.title_en: A First-Principles Multiscale Framework for Topological Superconductivity
core_items.title_zh: 拓扑超导的第一性原理多尺度框架
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2609.10381v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A microscopic understanding of topological superconductivity (TSC) in real materials requires a materials-informed approach that integrates first-principles electronic structure, superconductivity, and topology within a unified computational framework. Here, we develop such an approach by combining density functional theory, Wannier-based low-energy Hamiltonians, Bogoliubov-de Gennes theory, and Matsubara Green's-function-based Chern number calculations performed directly on realistic multiorbital superconducting Hamiltonians. We apply this framework to bulk-like and monolayer FeTeSe and to FeSe/GaAs heterostructures, enabling a unified investigation of both intrinsic and proximity-induced topological superconductivity. We identify key electronic-structure ingredients that promote robust TSC, including Rashba-active states near the Fermi level, strong induced superconducting pairing, and substantial orbital hybridization between spin-orbit-active and superconducting sectors. Guided by these design principles, we predict multiple topological superconducting phases in Fe-based materials and demonstrate that FeSe/GaAs heterostructures are particularly promising, exhibiting topological transitions at experimentally accessible chemical potentials and low Zeeman fields. Complementing the theoretical predictions, we demonstrate the growth and structural characterization of FeSe/GaAs heterostructures, establishing the experimental feasibility of the proposed materials platform. Our results provide a quantitative route for engineering and screening candidate Majorana materials and heterostructures directly from realistic electronic structures and establish a foundation for future materials-by-design approaches to topological superconductivity.
core_items.abstract_zh: 该工作构建了一个将密度泛函理论、Wannier低能哈密顿量、Bogoliubov-de Gennes理论和基于Matsubara格林函数的陈数计算结合起来的拓扑超导计算框架。该框架被用于块体和单层FeTeSe以及FeSe/GaAs异质结构，识别出费米能级附近Rashba活性态、强诱导配对和轨道杂化等促进稳健拓扑超导的关键因素。研究预测FeSe/GaAs具有实验可及化学势和低塞曼场下的拓扑转变，并展示了该异质结构的生长与结构表征。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 对真实材料中拓扑超导性（TSC）的微观理解，需要一种材料信息驱动的方法，在统一的计算框架内整合第一性原理电子结构、超导性和拓扑性。本文通过结合密度泛函理论、基于Wannier的低能哈密顿量、Bogoliubov-de Gennes理论，以及直接在真实多轨道超导哈密顿量上进行的基于Matsubara格林函数的陈数计算，发展了这样一种方法。我们将该框架应用于块体类和单层FeTeSe，以及FeSe/GaAs异质结构，从而能够统一研究本征和近邻诱导的拓扑超导性。我们识别出促进稳健TSC的关键电子结构要素，包括费米能级附近的Rashba活性态、强的诱导超导配对，以及自旋轨道活性部分与超导部分之间显著的轨道杂化。在这些设计原则指导下，我们预测了铁基材料中的多个拓扑超导相，并表明FeSe/GaAs异质结构尤其具有前景，其在实验可及的化学势和低塞曼场下表现出拓扑转变。作为对理论预测的补充，我们展示了FeSe/GaAs异质结构的生长和结构表征，确立了所提出材料平台的实验可行性。我们的结果为直接从真实电子结构设计和筛选候选Majorana材料及异质结构提供了一条定量路径，并为未来面向拓扑超导的材料设计方法奠定了基础。
core_items.summary: 该工作构建了一个将密度泛函理论、Wannier低能哈密顿量、Bogoliubov-de Gennes理论和基于Matsubara格林函数的陈数计算结合起来的拓扑超导计算框架。该框架被用于块体和单层FeTeSe以及FeSe/GaAs异质结构，识别出费米能级附近Rashba活性态、强诱导配对和轨道杂化等促进稳健拓扑超导的关键因素。研究预测FeSe/GaAs具有实验可及化学势和低塞曼场下的拓扑转变，并展示了该异质结构的生长与结构表征。
core_items.focus_summary: 本文建立融合第一性原理电子结构、Wannier低能哈密顿量、Bogoliubov-de Gennes理论和基于Matsubara格林函数的陈数计算的拓扑超导多尺度框架。该框架应用于FeTeSe、单层FeSe及FeSe/GaAs异质结构，预测了由Rashba态、超导配对和轨道杂化共同促进的多种拓扑超导相。
core_items.focus_relation: 与我们的超导、拓扑材料、Wannier插值、有效或从头算哈密顿量、界面异质结构和自旋轨道耦合方向高度相关。其将真实材料第一性原理结果直接映射到超导拓扑模型的策略，可借鉴到磁性超导体、二维异质结和拓扑磁性材料设计中。
core_items.focus_suggestion: 建议进一步考察磁序、应变、缺陷和界面无序对拓扑超导相及马约拉纳边界态的影响，并结合自旋哈密顿量或自洽电子-声子耦合。也可阅读其Wannier化与拓扑不变量计算流程，评估在团队现有材料高通量筛选和机器学习哈密顿量中的应用。
core_items.method_point: 该文建立从DFT到Wannier低能模型、Bogoliubov-de Gennes方程及Matsubara格林函数陈数的多尺度流程，以判定拓扑超导而非仅凭能带反转推断。作者用于块体和单层FeTeSe及FeSe/GaAs异质结，先分辨费米能附近Rashba活性态与轨道杂化，再加入诱导配对和塞曼场求解BdG谱及拓扑不变量。框架指出FeSe/GaAs在实验可及化学势、较低塞曼场附近发生转变，并同时报告异质结构的生长和结构表征；可靠性取决于Wannier窗口、SOC、配对参数和界面电荷转移的收敛。
core_items.related_work: 该路线与团队已有Wannier、BdG、量子输运和高温超导筛选能力高度匹配，比只以DFT能带计算Z2指标更能处理超导配对、磁场和化学势依赖。Xin-Gao Gong及Ji-Hui Yang对FeSe电子-声子耦合、超导和异质界面的研究可直接提供输入物理；Hongjun Xiang对磁序和SOC对称性的分析则适用于确定允许的Rashba与Zeeman项。它与铁电界面调控也存在交叉：BaTiO3或HfO2极化可改变界面电场和Rashba项，但不能在未计算屏蔽、电荷转移和配对来源前宣称产生拓扑相。
core_items.implication: 可针对FeSe/BaTiO3、FeSe/HfO2或FeSe/GaAs建立含不同终止面和极化方向的界面超胞，以DFT+SOC弛豫并计算层分辨电荷、势阶和Rashba劈裂。用Wannier90构造Fe-d与界面相关轨道模型，按DFT或实验约束扫描化学势、诱导s波配对和面内外Zeeman场，采用Matsubara陈数与边缘谱双重判定相界。验证应包含不同Wannier投影和k网格收敛、极化翻转前后的可逆拓扑区间，以及与ARPES能带或STM零能边缘态的可观测特征对应。

core_items.title_en: First-principles investigation of structural, mechanical, vibrational, thermal, electronic and optical properties of Na3Bi: a topological Dirac semimetal
core_items.title_zh: Na3Bi结构、力学、振动、热学、电子与光学性质的第一性原理研究：一种拓扑狄拉克半金属
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2609.09720v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Exploring the properties of topological materials has remained an active area of research in condensed matter physics for the past few decades. Here, we present a first-principles investigation of the structural, elasto-mechanical, thermal, electronic, and optical properties of Na3Bi, one of the earliest discovered topological Dirac semimetals, using density functional theory. The hexagonal phase of Na3Bi is found to be both mechanically and dynamically stable, exhibiting moderate elastic anisotropy with a universal anisotropy index of 0.832. The compound displays a moderate machinability index of 2.386 alongside a low hardness value of 2.005, consistent with its predominantly brittle, covalently bonded character accompanied by a slight metallic contribution. Its comparatively low Debye temperature of 181.39K points to a mechanically soft lattice with loosely bound atoms. Electronic structure calculations confirm semimetallic behavior, with well-defined Dirac points pinned at the Fermi level and a Fermi surface composed of point-like pockets. Optical analysis across a wide spectral range reveals non-selective, moderate reflectivity of 40 to 45% and, in the visible region, an unusually high refractive index reaching between 2 and 4.5. Na3Bi is additionally found to be an efficient absorber of ultraviolet radiation. Together, these findings establish a comprehensive baseline for the mechanical, thermal, and optical behavior of hexagonal Na3Bi and point to its potential relevance for acoustic damping, UV-sensing, and optoelectronic applications
core_items.abstract_zh: 本文基于密度泛函理论，系统研究了Na3Bi六方相的结构、弹性力学、热学、电子和光学性质。结果表明，Na3Bi具有机械和动力学稳定性，费米能级处存在清晰的狄拉克点，并表现出中等反射率、高可见光折射率和优良的紫外吸收能力。其性质表明，该材料在声学阻尼、紫外传感和光电器件领域具有潜在应用价值。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 在过去几十年中，拓扑材料性质的探索一直是凝聚态物理学中活跃的研究领域。本文利用密度泛函理论，对Na3Bi这一最早发现的拓扑狄拉克半金属之一的结构、弹性力学、热学、电子和光学性质进行了第一性原理研究。研究发现，Na3Bi的六方相在机械和动力学上均稳定，并表现出中等程度的弹性各向异性，其普适各向异性指数为0.832。该化合物的可加工性指数为2.386，属于中等水平；硬度值较低，为2.005，这与其以脆性、共价键合特征为主并伴有轻微金属性贡献的性质相一致。其相对较低的德拜温度为181.39 K，表明该材料晶格较软，原子之间的束缚较弱。电子结构计算证实其具有半金属性，在费米能级处存在定义清晰的狄拉克点，且费米面由点状口袋构成。在宽广的光谱范围内进行的光学分析表明，该材料具有40%至45%的非选择性中等反射率；在可见光区域，其折射率异常高，可达到2至4.5。研究还发现，Na3Bi能够有效吸收紫外辐射。总体而言，这些结果为六方Na3Bi的力学、热学和光学行为建立了全面基线，并指出其在声学阻尼、紫外传感和光电器件应用中的潜在价值。
core_items.summary: 本文基于密度泛函理论，系统研究了Na3Bi六方相的结构、弹性力学、热学、电子和光学性质。结果表明，Na3Bi具有机械和动力学稳定性，费米能级处存在清晰的狄拉克点，并表现出中等反射率、高可见光折射率和优良的紫外吸收能力。其性质表明，该材料在声学阻尼、紫外传感和光电器件领域具有潜在应用价值。
core_items.focus_summary: 该工作采用密度泛函理论系统计算Na3Bi拓扑狄拉克半金属的结构、力学、声子、热学、电子和光学性质。结果确认其六方相具有力学和动力学稳定性、较软晶格及费米能级附近的狄拉克点，并给出宽光谱范围内的光学响应。
core_items.focus_relation: 与团队的第一性原理计算、拓扑材料、电子结构和光学性质研究相关，但工作以常规材料性质表征为主。其结果可作为开展拓扑材料光电响应、应变调控和输运研究的基础数据。
core_items.focus_suggestion: 可结合Wannier插值进一步计算贝里曲率、表面态和量子输运，并考察应变、缺陷或异质结对狄拉克态及光学选择定则的调控。若关注激发态性质，可补充GW-BSE和电子-声子耦合计算。
core_items.method_point: 该文以第一性原理系统计算六方Na3Bi的结构、弹性、声子、热学、电子和光学性质，并以费米能附近的狄拉克点识别其拓扑狄拉克半金属性。计算链条通常包括几何优化后求应力响应和声子色散以检验机械及动力学稳定性，再由电子能带和介电函数导出反射率、折射率和吸收谱。摘要报告中等反射率、较高可见光折射率和紫外吸收，但未给出交换相关泛函、SOC处理、声子超胞或光学展宽，故对狄拉克节点位置和光谱强度的定量结论需以含SOC高精度复算确认。
core_items.related_work: 此类完整性质图谱与拓扑半金属的常规DFT筛选相呼应，但其方法本身没有机器学习环节，属于可为ML哈密顿量或高通量性质模型提供标签的基础工作。它和Xin-Gao Gong的Wannier量子输运、Ji-Hui Yang的二维材料光学与载流子输运方向相接，也可与Hongyu Yu的机器学习Kohn-Sham哈密顿量结合以加速SOC能带。Na3Bi不同于CrI3、CrSBr等磁性体系，不含自发磁序；若讨论磁掺杂或铁电界面诱导拓扑转变，必须额外计算交换场、结构稳定性和对称性破缺。
core_items.implication: 可用Na3Bi作为含强SOC拓扑材料的ML哈密顿量基准：在体相、应变、层数、表面和缺陷构型上生成含SOC的DFT数据，并以能带、速度矩阵和轨道投影监督等变模型。由模型快速筛选应变和电场条件，再对候选点执行Wannier插值，计算Wilson环、表面谱、Berry曲率及玻尔兹曼输运。实验相关验证可对接ARPES狄拉克点位置、红外或椭偏光谱和霍尔迁移率；同时以DFT声子和有限温MD排除仅电子上拓扑、结构上不稳定的候选状态。

core_items.title_en: Evidence of Haldane-Chain Physics in an Fe-Dehydroindigo Coordination Polymer
core_items.title_zh: 铁-脱氢靛蓝配位聚合物中Haldane链物理的证据
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2609.06684v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate whether an Fe--dehydroindigo coordination polymer can support Haldane-chain physics in its intrinsic, substrate-free limit. Spin-orbit-coupled density-functional-theory calculations and magnetic energy mapping yield a nearly isotropic antiferromagnetic coupling, together with much weaker single-ion anisotropy. Using these parameters, exact diagonalization and density-matrix renormalization group calculations give a nondegenerate ground state separated from the lowest triplet-derived excitations by a gap of about 13--14~meV, on the scale expected for the spin-1 Haldane gap. The anisotropy produces only a small splitting of the low-energy modes. The dynamical spin structure factor places the lowest spectral weight near the antiferromagnetic wave vector q=π. These results identify the isolated cis-dehydroindigo chain as a material-specific coordination-polymer platform whose microscopic interactions place it in a gapped regime consistent with Haldane-chain physics.
core_items.abstract_zh: 该研究考察铁-脱氢靛蓝自旋交叉配位聚合物在本征无衬底极限下是否支持Haldane链物理。自旋轨道耦合密度泛函理论、磁能映射、精确对角化和密度矩阵重整化群计算显示，该体系具有近各向同性反铁磁耦合和约13–14 meV的能隙，符合自旋1 Haldane能隙的预期尺度。动态自旋结构因子的低能谱权重位于反铁磁波矢附近，支持其作为Haldane链物理材料平台的判定。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2609.06684v1；通告类型：新稿。摘要：我们研究一种铁-脱氢靛蓝自旋交叉配位聚合物在其本征、无衬底极限下是否能够支持Haldane链物理。自旋轨道耦合密度泛函理论计算和磁能映射给出了近乎各向同性的反铁磁耦合J_H = 32.206 meV，同时单离子各向异性要弱得多。利用这些参数，精确对角化和密度矩阵重整化群计算得到一个非简并基态，该基态与最低的三重态衍生激发之间相隔约13–14 meV的能隙，其尺度符合自旋1 Haldane能隙的预期。各向异性仅导致低能模发生很小的劈裂。动态自旋结构因子将最低谱权重定位在反铁磁波矢q = π附近。这些结果将孤立的顺式脱氢靛蓝链识别为一个具有材料特异性的配位聚合物平台，其微观相互作用使其处于与Haldane链物理一致的有能隙区域。
core_items.summary: 该研究考察铁-脱氢靛蓝自旋交叉配位聚合物在本征无衬底极限下是否支持Haldane链物理。自旋轨道耦合密度泛函理论、磁能映射、精确对角化和密度矩阵重整化群计算显示，该体系具有近各向同性反铁磁耦合和约13–14 meV的能隙，符合自旋1 Haldane能隙的预期尺度。动态自旋结构因子的低能谱权重位于反铁磁波矢附近，支持其作为Haldane链物理材料平台的判定。
core_items.method_point: 该研究以自旋轨道耦合DFT计算铁-脱氢靛蓝配位聚合物的磁构型能量，再经磁能映射得到近各向同性反铁磁交换参数，并用精确对角化和密度矩阵重整化群求一维自旋模型。计算得到约13至14 meV的能隙，动态自旋结构因子低能权重集中在反铁磁波矢，与整数自旋1链的Haldane能隙相符。方法的判别力来自同时比较基态能隙和动量分辨激发谱，而非把反铁磁交换本身等同于Haldane相；基底、有限链长和各向异性仍是实验实现中的关键扰动。
core_items.related_work: 它对应从DFT到自旋哈密顿量再到多体求解的标准多尺度磁性路线，与Hongjun Xiang的交换、Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用和自旋动力学，以及Hongyu Yu的自旋-晶格耦合建模直接一致。相对于CrI3、CrSBr等二维局域磁体，该体系的核心是配位聚合物中的准一维S=1拓扑量子磁性，低维涨落不能由经典蒙特卡洛替代。团队在非共线磁性和SOC-DFT方面的经验可用于检验单离子各向异性、链间交换及DMI是否破坏受保护的Haldane能隙。
core_items.implication: 可按DFT+U+SOC对该聚合物及配体、金属替换体系计算多组共线和非共线磁态，采用能量映射与受约束自旋方法同时拟合链内外J、单离子D、交换各向异性和DMI。将参数输入有限温DMRG或张量网络，计算不同链长、磁场和应变下的能隙、边缘自旋与动态结构因子；MLIP可用于采样热振动构型并拟合J对键长和扭角的依赖。验证需以中子散射或RIXS的S(q,w)、磁化率及磁场闭隙行为为目标，并通过基底吸附DFT量化链间耦合是否仍低于Haldane能隙。

core_direction_note: 本日的实质进展集中在把物理对称性和有限温度核量子效应直接写入学习与结构搜索流程：TorFormer以平移等变性处理二维电子气的费米液体和维格纳晶体，SSCHA结合机器学习势处理轻元素晶体的非谐自由能。二维磁体筛选将八面体晶场描述符用于垂直磁各向异性预测，可直接衔接CrI3、CrSBr等范德华磁体的SOC与自旋哈密顿量研究。FeTeSe、FeSe/GaAs与Fe-脱氢靛蓝体系分别把Wannier-BdG拓扑判据和DFT磁交换映射推进到可计算材料平台，亦可与HfO2、BaTiO3等极性材料的界面调控问题交叉。
